**Architecture:** 采用微信云开发架构，前端使用微信小程序原生框架，后端使用微信云数据库和云函数

**Tech Stack:**
- 前端：微信小程序原生框架 (WXML + WXSS + JavaScript)
- 后端：微信云开发 (云数据库、云存储、云函数)
- 数据处理：xlsx库 (Excel解析)

```
fabric-quotation/
├── miniprogram/
│   ├── app.js
│   ├── app.json
│   ├── app.wxss
│   ├── project.config.json
│   ├── pages/
│   │   ├── index/          # 首页/面料列表
│   │   ├── fabric-detail/ # 面料详情
│   │   ├── fabric-edit/   # 面料编辑

│       ├── index.js
│       └── package.json
└── docs/
```

### Task 1: 项目初始化

**Files:**
- Create: `miniprogram/app.js`
- Create: `miniprogram/app.json`
- Create: `miniprogram/app.wxss`
- Create: `miniprogram/project.config.json`

- [ ] **Step 1: 创建app.js - 小程序入口文件**

```javascript
App({
  onLaunch: function () {
    if (!wx.cloud) {
      console.error('请使用 2.2.3 或以上的基础库以使用云能力');
    } else {
      wx.cloud.init({
        env: 'your-env-id',
        traceUser: true,
      });
    }
  },
  globalData: {
    userInfo: null
  }
});
```

- [ ] **Step 2: 创建app.json - 小程序配置文件**

```json
{
  "pages": [
    "pages/index/index",
    "pages/fabric-detail/fabric-detail",
    "pages/fabric-edit/fabric-edit",
    "pages/quotation/quotation",
    "pages/history/history"
  ],
  "window": {
    "backgroundTextStyle": "light",
    "navigationBarBackgroundColor": "#fff",
    "navigationBarTitleText": "面料报价",
    "navigationBarTextStyle": "black"
  },
  "tabBar": {
    "list": [
      {
        "pagePath": "pages/index/index",
        "text": "面料"
      },
      {
        "pagePath": "pages/quotation/quotation",
        "text": "报价"
      },
      {
        "pagePath": "pages/history/history",
        "text": "历史"
      }
    ]
  },
  "cloud": true
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: 创建app.wxss - 全局样式**

```css
page {
  background-color: #f5f5f5;
  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Roboto', 'Oxygen', 'Ubuntu', 'Cantarell', 'Fira Sans', 'Droid Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif;
}

.container {
  padding: 20rpx;
}

.card {
  background: white;
  border-radius: 16rpx;
  padding: 30rpx;
  margin-bottom: 20rpx;
  box-shadow: 0 2rpx 12rpx rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
}

.btn {
  background: #07c160;
  color: white;
  border-radius: 8rpx;
  padding: 24rpx;
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 32rpx;
  margin: 20rpx 0;
}

.btn-primary {
  background: #07c160;
}

.btn-secondary {
  background: #1989fa;
}
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 创建project.config.json - 项目配置**

```json
{
  "miniprogramRoot": "miniprogram/",
  "cloudfunctionRoot": "cloudfunctions/",
  "setting": {
    "urlCheck": false,
    "es6": true,
    "enhance": true,
    "postcss": true,
    "preloadBackgroundData": false,

    "showShadowRootInWxmlPanel": true,

    "checkInvalidKey": true,
    "checkSiteMap": true# 面料报价微信小程序 - 轻量化实施计划

**Goal:** 构建一个极简的面料报价微信小程序，使用微信云开发，支持面料管理、报价生成和历史记录功能

**Goal:** 构建一个极简的面料报价微信小程序，使用微信云开发，支持面料管理、报价生成和历史记录功能

**Architecture:** 采用微信云开发架构，前端使用微信小程序原生框架，后端使用微信云数据库和云函数

**Tech Stack:**
- 前端：微信小程序原生框架 (WXML + WXSS + JavaScript)
- 后端：微信云开发 (云数据库、云存储、云函数)
- 数据处理：xlsx库 (Excel解析)

```javascript
App({
  onLaunch: function () {
    if (!wx.cloud) {
      console.error('请使用 2.2.3 或以上的基础库以使用云能力');
    } else {
      wx.cloud.init({
        env: 'your-env-id',
        traceUser: true,
      });
    }
  },
  globalData: {
    userInfo: null
  }
});
```

  },
  "cloud": true
}

**Goal:** 构建一个极简的面料报价微信小程序，使用微信云开发，支持面料管理、报价生成和历史记录功能

**Architecture:** 采用微信云开发架构，前端使用微信小程序原生框架，后端使用微信云数据库和云函数

- 后端：微信云开发 (云数据库、云存储、云函数)
- 数据处理：xlsx库 (Excel解析)

### Task 1: 项目初始化

**Files:**
- Create: `miniprogram/app.js`
- Create: `miniprogram/app.json`
- Create: `miniprogram/app.wxss`
- Create: `miniprogram/project.config.json`

- [ ] **Step 1: 创建app.js - 小程序入口文件**

```javascript
App({
  onLaunch: function () {
    if (!wx.cloud) {
      console.error('请使用 2.2.3 或以上的基础库以使用云能力');
    } else {
      wx.cloud.init({
        env: 'your-env-id',
        traceUser: true,
      });
    }
  },
  globalData: {
    userInfo: null
  }
});
```

- [ ] **Step 2: 创建app.json - 小程序配置文件**

```json
{
  "pages": [
    "pages/index/index",
    "pages/fabric-detail/fabric-detail",
    "pages/fabric-edit/fabric-edit",
    "pages/quotation/quotation",
    "pages/history/history"
  ],
  "window": {
    "backgroundTextStyle": "light",
    "navigationBarBackgroundColor": "#fff",
    "navigationBarTitleText": "面料报价",
    "navigationBarTextStyle": "black"
  },
  "tabBar": {
    "list": [
      {
        "pagePath": "pages/index/index",
        "text": "面料"
      },
      {
        "pagePath": "pages/quotation/quotation",
        "text": "报价"
      },
      {
        "pagePath": "pages/history/history",
        "text": "历史"
      }
    ]
  },
  "cloud": true
}
```

```css

  margin: 20rpx 0;
}

}

  background: #1989fa;
}
```

**Goal:** 构建一个极简的面料报价微信小程序，使用微信云开发，支持面料管理、报价生成和历史记录功能

**Architecture:** 采用微信云开发架构，前端使用微信小程序原生框架，后端使用微信云数据库和云函数

**Tech Stack:**
- 前端：微信小程序原生框架 (WXML + WXSS + JavaScript)
- 后端：微信云开发 (云数据库、云存储、云函数)
- 数据处理：xlsx库 (Excel解析)

**Goal:** 构建一个极简的面料报价微信小程序，使用微信云开发，支持面料管理、报价生成和历史记录功能

**Architecture:** 采用微信云开发架构，前端使用微信小程序原生框架，后端使用微信云数据库和云函数

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

      wx.cloud.init({

  }
});

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

**Goal:** 构建一个极简的面料报价微信小程序，使用微信云开发，支持面料管理、报价生成和历史记录功能

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

**Goal:** 构建一个极简的面料报价微信小程序，使用微信云开发，支持面料管理、报价生成和历史记录功能

**Architecture:** 采用微信云开发架构，前端使用微信小程序原生框架，后端使用微信云数据库和云函数

**Tech Stack:**
- 前端：微信小程序原生框架 (WXML + WXSS + JavaScript)
- 后端：微信云开发 (云数据库、云存储、云函数)
- 数据处理：xlsx库 (Excel解析)

**Architecture:** 采用微信云开发架构，前端使用微信小程序原生框架，后端使用微信云数据库和云函数

**Tech Stack:**
- 前端：微信小程序原生框架 (WXML + WXSS + JavaScript)
- 后端：微信云开发 (云数据库、云存储、云函数)
- 数据处理：xlsx库 (Excel解析)

---

## 文件结构映射

```
fabric-quotation/
├── miniprogram/
│   ├── app.js
│   ├── app.json
│   ├── app.wxss
│   ├── project.config.json
│   ├── pages/
│   │   ├── index/          # 首页/面料列表
│   │   ├── fabric-detail/ # 面料详情
│   │   ├── fabric-edit/   # 面料编辑
│   │   ├── quotation/     # 新建报价
│   │   └── history/       # 报价历史
│   └── utils/
│       └── util.js
├── cloudfunctions/
│   └── importExcel/       # Excel导入云函数
│       ├── index.js
│       └── package.json
└── docs/
```

### Task 1: 项目初始化

**Files:**
- Create: `miniprogram/app.js`
- Create: `miniprogram/app.json`
- Create: `miniprogram/app.wxss`
- Create: `miniprogram/project.config.json`

- [ ] **Step 1: 创建app.js - 小程序入口文件**

```javascript
App({
  onLaunch: function () {
    if (!wx.cloud) {
      console.error('请使用 2.2.3 或以上的基础库以使用云能力');
    } else {
      wx.cloud.init({
        env: 'your-env-id',
        traceUser: true,
      });
    }
  },
  globalData: {
    userInfo: null
  }
});
```

- [ ] **Step 2: 创建app.json - 小程序配置文件**

```json
{
  "pages": [
    "pages/index/index",
    "pages/fabric-detail/fabric-detail",
    "pages/fabric-edit/fabric-edit",
    "pages/quotation/quotation",
    "pages/history/history"
  ],
  "window": {
    "backgroundTextStyle": "light",
    "navigationBarBackgroundColor": "#fff",
    "navigationBarTitleText": "面料报价",
    "navigationBarTextStyle": "black"
  },
  "tabBar": {
    "list": [
      {
        "pagePath": "pages/index/index",
        "text": "面料"
      },
      {
        "pagePath": "pages/quotation/quotation",
        "text": "报价"
      },
      {
        "pagePath": "pages/history/history",
        "text": "历史"
      }
    ]
  },
  "cloud": true
}
```

- [ ] **Step 3: 创建app.wxss - 全局样式**

```css
page {
  background-color: #f5f5f5;
  font-family: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, 'Segoe UI', 'Roboto', 'Oxygen', 'Ubuntu', 'Cantarell', 'Fira Sans', 'Droid Sans', 'Helvetica Neue', sans-serif;
}

.container {
  padding: 20rpx;
}

.card {
  background: white;
  border-radius: 16rpx;
  padding: 30rpx;
  margin-bottom: 20rpx;
  box-shadow: 0 2rpx 12rpx rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.08);
}

.btn {
  background: #07c160;

  border-radius: 8rpx;
  padding: 24rpx;
  text-align: center;
  font-size: 32rpx;
  margin: 20rpx 0;
}

.btn-primary {
  background: #07c160;
}

.btn-secondary {
  background: #1989fa;
}
```

```json
{

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

```html
<view class="container">
  <view class="search-bar">
    <input class="search-input" placeholder="搜索面料编号/名称" bindinput="onSearchInput" value="{{searchKeyword}}" />
    <button class="search-btn" bindtap="onSearch">搜索</button>
  </view>

  <view class="action-bar">
    <button class="btn btn-primary" bindtap="onImportExcel">导入Excel</button>
    <button class="btn btn-secondary" bindtap="onAddFabric">添加面料</button>
  </view>

  <view class="fabric-list">
    <view class="card" wx:for="{{fabrics}}" wx:key="_id" bindtap="goToDetail" data-id="{{item._id}}">
      <view class="fabric-header">
        <text class="fabric-code">{{item.new_code || item.code}}</text>
        <text class="fabric-type">{{item.type}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-info">
        <text>幅宽: {{item.width}}</text>
        <text>克重: {{item.weight}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-price">
        <text>版布价: {{item.sample_price_meter}}元/米</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-composition">{{item.composition}}</view>
    </view>
  </view>

  <view class="empty" wx:if="{{fabrics.length === 0 && !loading}}">
    <text># 面料报价微信小程序 - 轻量化实施计划

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

**Goal:** 构建一个极简的面料报价微信小程序，使用微信云开发，支持面料管理、报价生成和历史记录功能

**Architecture:** 采用微信云开发架构，前端使用微信小程序原生框架，后端使用微信云数据库和云函数

**Tech Stack:**

- 后端：微信云开发 (云数据库、云存储、云函数)
- 数据处理：xlsx库 (Excel解析)

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

- [ ] **Step 2: 创建index.wxml - 页面结构**

```html
<view class="container">
  <view class="search-bar">
    <input class="search-input" placeholder="搜索面料编号/名称" bindinput="onSearchInput" value="{{searchKeyword}}" />
    <button class="search-btn" bindtap="onSearch">搜索</button>
  </view>

  <view class="action-bar">
    <button class="btn btn-primary" bindtap="onImportExcel">导入Excel</button>
    <button class="btn btn-secondary" bindtap="onAddFabric">添加面料</button>
  </view>

  <view class="fabric-list">
    <view class="card" wx:for="{{fabrics}}" wx:key="_id" bindtap="goToDetail" data-id="{{item._id}}">
      <view class="fabric-header">
        <text class="fabric-code">{{item.new_code || item.code}}</text>
        <text class="fabric-type">{{item.type}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-info">
        <text>幅宽: {{item.width}}</text>
        <text>克重: {{item.weight}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-price">
        <text>版布价: {{item.sample_price_meter}}元/米</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-composition">{{item.composition}}</view>
    </view>
  </view>

  <view class="empty" wx:if="{{fabrics.length === 0 && !loading}}">
    <text>暂无面料数据，请先导入Excel</text>
  </view>

  <view class="loading" wx:if="{{loading}}">
    <text>加载中...</text>
  </view>
</view>
```

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** 构建一个极简的面料报价微信小程序，使用微信云开发，支持面料管理、报价生成和历史记录功能

**Architecture:** 采用微信云开发架构，前端使用微信小程序原生框架，后端使用微信云数据库和云函数

**Tech Stack:**
- 前端：微信小程序原生框架 (WXML + WXSS + JavaScript)
- 后端：微信云开发 (云数据库、云存储、云函数)
- 数据处理：xlsx库 (Excel解析)

    <input class="search-input" placeholder="搜索面料编号/名称" bindinput="onSearchInput" value="{{searchKeyword}}" />
    <button class="search-btn" bindtap="onSearch">搜索</button>
  </view>

  <view class="action-bar">
    <button class="btn btn-primary" bindtap="onImportExcel">导入Excel</button>
    <button class="btn btn-secondary" bindtap="onAddFabric">添加面料</button>
  </view>

  <view class="fabric-list">
    <view class="card" wx:for="{{fabrics}}" wx:key="_id" bindtap="goToDetail" data-id="{{item._id}}">
      <view class="fabric-header">
        <text class="fabric-code">{{item.new_code || item.code}}</text>
        <text class="fabric-type">{{item.type}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-info">
        <text>幅宽: {{item.width}}</text>
        <text>克重: {{item.weight}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-price">
        <text>版布价: {{item.sample_price_meter}}元/米</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-composition">{{item.composition}}</view>
    </view>
  </view>

  <view class="empty" wx:if="{{fabrics.length === 0 && !loading}}">
    <text>暂无面料数据，请先导入Excel</text>
  </view>

  <view class="loading" wx:if="{{loading}}">
    <text>加载中...</text>
  </view>
</view>
```

**Goal:** 构建一个极简的面料报价微信小程序，使用微信云开发，支持面料管理、报价生成和历史记录功能

**Architecture:** 采用微信云开发架构，前端使用微信小程序原生框架，后端使用微信云数据库和云函数

**Tech Stack:**
- 前端：微信小程序原生框架 (WXML + WXSS + JavaScript)
- 后端：微信云开发 (云数据库、云存储、云函数)
- 数据处理：xlsx库 (Excel解析)

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

```html
<view class="container">
  <view class="search-bar">
    <input class="search-input" placeholder="搜索面料编号/名称" bindinput="onSearchInput" value="{{searchKeyword}}" />
    <button class="search-btn" bindtap="onSearch">搜索</button>
  </view>

  <view class="action-bar">
    <button class="btn btn-primary" bindtap="onImportExcel">导入Excel</button>
    <button class="btn btn-secondary" bindtap="onAddFabric">添加面料</button>
  </view>

  <view class="fabric-list">
    <view class="card" wx:for="{{fabrics}}" wx:key="_id" bindtap="goToDetail" data-id="{{item._id}}">
      <view class="fabric-header">
        <text class="fabric-code">{{item.new_code || item.code}}</text>
        <text class="fabric-type">{{item.type}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-info">
        <text>幅宽: {{item.width}}</text>
        <text>克重: {{item.weight}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-price">
        <text>版布价: {{item.sample_price_meter}}元/米</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-composition">{{item.composition}}</view>
    </view>
  </view>

  <view class="empty" wx:if="{{fabrics.length === 0 && !loading}}">
    <text>暂无面料数据，请先导入Excel</text>
  </view>

  <view class="loading" wx:if="{{loading}}">
    <text>加载中...</text>
  </view>
</view>

    <input class="search-input" placeholder="搜索面料编号/名称" bindinput="onSearchInput" value="{{searchKeyword}}" />
    <button class="search-btn" bindtap="onSearch">搜索</button>
  </view>

  <view class="action-bar">
    <button class="btn btn-primary" bindtap="onImportExcel">导入Excel</button>
    <button class="btn btn-secondary" bindtap="onAddFabric">添加面料</button>
  </view>

  <view class="fabric-list">
    <view class="card" wx:for="{{fabrics}}" wx:key="_id" bindtap="goToDetail" data-id="{{item._id}}">
      <view class="fabric-header">
        <text class="fabric-code">{{item.new_code || item.code}}</text>
        <text class="fabric-type">{{item.type}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-info">
        <text>幅宽: {{item.width}}</text>
        <text>克重: {{item.weight}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-price">
        <text>版布价: {{item.sample_price_meter}}元/米</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-composition">{{item.composition}}</view>
    </view>
  </view>

  <view class="empty" wx:if="{{fabrics.length === 0 && !loading}}">
    <text>暂无面料数据，请先导入Excel</text>
  </view>

  <view class="loading" wx:if="{{loading}}">
    <text>加载中...</text>
  </view>
</view>
```

**Goal:** 构建一个极简的面料报价微信小程序，使用微信云开发，支持面料管理、报价生成和历史记录功能

**Architecture:** 采用微信云开发架构，前端使用微信小程序原生框架，后端使用微信云数据库和云函数

**Tech Stack:**
- 前端：微信小程序原生框架 (WXML + WXSS + JavaScript)
- 后端：微信云开发 (云数据库、云存储、云函数)
- 数据处理：xlsx库 (Excel解析)

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

```html
<view class="container">
  <view class="search-bar">
    <input class="search-input" placeholder="搜索面料编号/名称" bindinput="onSearchInput" value="{{searchKeyword}}" />
    <button class="search-btn" bindtap="onSearch">搜索</button>
  </view>

  <view class="action-bar">
    <button class="btn btn-primary" bindtap="onImportExcel">导入Excel</button>
    <button class="btn btn-secondary" bindtap="onAddFabric">添加面料</button>
  </view>

  <view class="fabric-list">
    <view class="card" wx:for="{{fabrics}}" wx:key="_id" bindtap="goToDetail" data-id="{{item._id}}">
      <view class="fabric-header">
        <text class="fabric-code">{{item.new_code || item.code}}</text>
        <text class="fabric-type">{{item.type}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-info">
        <text>幅宽: {{item.width}}</text>
        <text>克重: {{item.weight}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-price">
        <text>版布价: {{item.sample_price_meter}}元/米</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-composition">{{item.composition}}</view>
    </view>
  </view>

  <view class="empty" wx:if="{{fabrics.length === 0 && !loading}}">
    <text>暂无面料数据，请先导入Excel</text>
  </view>

  <view class="loading" wx:if="{{loading}}">
    <text>加载中...</text>
  </view>
</view>
```

**Goal:** 构建一个极简的面料报价微信小程序，使用微信云开发，支持面料管理、报价生成和历史记录功能

**Architecture:** 采用微信云开发架构，前端使用微信小程序原生框架，后端使用微信云数据库和云函数

**Tech Stack:**
- 前端：微信小程序原生框架 (WXML + WXSS + JavaScript)
- 后端：微信云开发 (云数据库、云存储、云函数)
- 数据处理：xlsx库 (Excel解析)

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

.fabric# 面料报价微信小程序 - 轻量化实施计划

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** 构建一个极简的面料报价微信小程序，使用微信云开发，支持面料管理、报价生成和历史记录功能

**Architecture:** 采用微信云开发架构，前端使用微信小程序原生框架，后端使用微信云数据库和云函数

**Tech Stack:**
- 前端：微信小程序原生框架 (WXML + WXSS + JavaScript)
- 后端：微信云开发 (云数据库、云存储、云函数)
- 数据处理：xlsx库 (Excel解析)

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** 构建一个极简的面料报价微信小程序，使用微信云开发，支持面料管理、报价生成和历史记录功能

**Architecture:** 采用微信云开发架构，前端使用微信小程序原生框架，后端使用微信云数据库和云函数

**Tech Stack:**
- 前端：微信小程序原生框架 (WXML + WXSS + JavaScript)
- 后端：微信云开发 (云数据库、云存储、云函数)
- 数据处理：xlsx库 (Excel解析)

---

## 文件结构映射

```
fabric-quotation/
├── miniprogram/
│   ├── app.js
│   ├── app.json
│   ├── app.wxss
│   ├── project.config.json
│   ├── pages/
│   │   ├── index/          # 首页/面料列表
│   │   ├── fabric-detail/ # 面料详情
│   │   ├── fabric-edit/   # 面料编辑
│   │   ├── quotation/     # 新建报价
│   │   └── history/       # 报价历史
│   └── utils/
│       └── util.js
├── cloudfunctions/
│   └── importExcel/       # Excel导入云函数
│       ├── index.js
│       └── package.json
└── docs/
```

```javascript
App({
  onLaunch: function () {
    if (!wx.cloud) {
      console.error('请使用 2.2.3 或以上的基础库以使用云能力');
    } else {
      wx.cloud.init({
        env: 'your-env-id',
        traceUser: true,
      });

  },
  globalData: {
    userInfo: null
  }
});
```

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

- [ ] **Step 2: 创建index.wxml - 页面结构**

```html
<view class="container">
  <view class="search-bar">
    <input class="search-input" placeholder="搜索面料编号/名称" bindinput="onSearchInput" value="{{searchKeyword}}" />
    <button class="search-btn" bindtap="onSearch">搜索</button>
  </view>

  <view class="action-bar">
    <button class="btn btn-primary" bindtap="onImportExcel">导入Excel</button>
    <button class="btn btn-secondary" bindtap="onAddFabric">添加面料</button>
  </view>

  <view class="fabric-list">
    <view class="card" wx:for="{{fabrics}}" wx:key="_id" bindtap="goToDetail" data-id="{{item._id}}">
      <view class="fabric-header">
        <text class="fabric-code">{{item.new_code || item.code}}</text>
        <text class="fabric-type">{{item.type}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-info">
        <text>幅宽: {{item.width}}</text>
        <text>克重: {{item.weight}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-price">
        <text>版布价: {{item.sample_price_meter}}元/米</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-composition">{{item.composition}}</view>
    </view>
  </view>

  <view class="empty" wx:if="{{fabrics.length === 0 && !loading}}">
    <text>暂无面料数据，请先导入Excel</text>
  </view>

  <view class="loading" wx:if="{{loading}}">
    <text>加载中...</text>
  </view>
</view>
```

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

```html
<view class="container">
  <view class="search-bar">
    <input class="search-input" placeholder="搜索面料编号/名称" bindinput="onSearchInput" value="{{searchKeyword}}" />
    <button class="search-btn" bindtap="onSearch">搜索</button>
  </view>

  <view class="action-bar">
    <button class="btn btn-primary" bindtap="onImportExcel">导入Excel</button>
    <button class="btn btn-secondary" bindtap="onAddFabric">添加面料</button>
  </view>

  <view class="fabric-list">
    <view class="card" wx:for="{{fabrics}}" wx:key="_id" bindtap="goToDetail" data-id="{{item._id}}">
      <view class="fabric-header">
        <text class="fabric-code">{{item.new_code || item.code}}</text>
        <text class="fabric-type">{{item.type}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-info">
        <text>幅宽: {{item.width}}</text>
        <text>克重: {{item.weight}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-price">
        <text>版布价: {{item.sample_price_meter}}元/米</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-composition">{{item.composition}}</view>
    </view>
  </view>

  <view class="empty" wx:if="{{fabrics.length === 0 && !loading}}">
    <text>暂无面料数据，请先导入Excel</text>
  </view>

  <view class="loading" wx:if="{{loading}}">
    <text>加载中...</text>
  </view>
</view>
```

**Goal:** 构建一个极简的面料报价微信小程序，使用微信云开发，支持面料管理、报价生成和历史记录功能

**Architecture:** 采用微信云开发架构，前端使用微信小程序原生框架，后端使用微信云数据库和云函数

**Tech Stack:**
- 前端：微信小程序原生框架 (WXML + WXSS + JavaScript)
- 后端：微信云开发 (云数据库、云存储、云函数)
- 数据处理：xlsx库 (Excel解析)

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

**Goal:** 构建一个极简的面料报价微信小程序，使用微信云开发，支持面料管理、报价生成和历史记录功能

**Architecture:** 采用微信云开发架构，前端使用微信小程序原生框架，后端使用微信云数据库和云函数

**Goal:** 构建一个极简的面料报价微信小程序，使用微信云开发，支持面料管理、报价生成和历史记录功能

**Architecture:** 采用微信云开发架构，前端使用微信小程序原生框架，后端使用微信云数据库和云函数

**Tech Stack:**
- 前端：微信小程序原生框架 (WXML + WXSS + JavaScript)
- 后端：微信云开发 (云数据库、云存储、云函数)
- 数据处理：xlsx库 (Excel解析)

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

```html
<view class="container">
  <view class="search-bar">
    <input class="search-input" placeholder="搜索面料编号/名称" bindinput="onSearchInput" value="{{searchKeyword}}" />
    <button class="search-btn" bindtap="onSearch">搜索</button>
  </view>

  <view class="action-bar">
    <button class="btn btn-primary" bindtap="onImportExcel">导入Excel</button>
    <button class="btn btn-secondary" bindtap="onAddFabric">添加面料</button>
  </view>

  <view class="fabric-list">
    <view class="card" wx:for="{{fabrics}}" wx:key="_id" bindtap="goToDetail" data-id="{{item._id}}">
      <view class="fabric-header">
        <text class="fabric-code">{{item.new_code || item.code}}</text>
        <text class="fabric-type">{{item.type}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-info">
        <text>幅宽: {{item.width}}</text>
        <text>克重: {{item.weight}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-price">
        <text>版布价: {{item.sample_price_meter}}元/米</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-composition">{{item.composition}}</view>
    </view>
  </view>

  <view class="empty" wx:if="{{fabrics.length === 0 && !loading}}">
    <text>暂无面料数据，请先导入Excel</text>
  </view>

  <view class="loading" wx:if="{{loading}}">
    <text>加载中...</text>
  </view>
</view>
```

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

```html
<view class="container">
  <view class="search-bar">
    <input class="search-input" placeholder="搜索面料编号/名称" bindinput="onSearchInput" value="{{searchKeyword}}" />
    <button class="search-btn" bindtap="onSearch">搜索</button>
  </view>

  <view class="action-bar">
    <button class="btn btn-primary" bindtap="onImportExcel">导入Excel</button>
    <button class="btn btn-secondary" bindtap="onAddFabric">添加面料</button>
  </view>

  <view class="fabric-list">
    <view class="card" wx:for="{{fabrics}}" wx:key="_id" bindtap="goToDetail" data-id="{{item._id}}">
      <view class="fabric-header">
        <text class="fabric-code">{{item.new_code || item.code}}</text>
        <text class="fabric-type">{{item.type}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-info">
        <text>幅宽: {{item.width}}</text>
        <text>克重: {{item.weight}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-price">
        <text>版布价: {{item.sample_price_meter}}元/米</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-composition">{{item.composition}}</view>
    </view>
  </view>

  <view class="empty" wx:if="{{fabrics.length === 0 && !loading}}">
    <text>暂无面料数据，请先导入Excel</text>
  </view>

  <view class="loading" wx:if="{{loading}}">
    <text>加载中...</text>
  </view>
</view>
```

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** 构建一个极简的面料报价微信小程序，使用微信云开发，支持面料管理、报价生成和历史记录功能

**Architecture:** 采用微信云开发架构，前端使用微信小程序原生框架，后端使用微信云数据库和云函数

**Tech Stack:**
- 前端：微信小程序原生框架 (WXML + WXSS + JavaScript)
- 后端：微信云开发 (云数据库、云存储、云函数)
- 数据处理：xlsx库 (Excel解析)

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

```html
<view class="container">
  <view class="search-bar">
    <input class="search-input" placeholder="搜索面料编号/名称" bindinput="onSearchInput" value="{{searchKeyword}}" />
    <button class="search-btn" bindtap="onSearch">搜索</button>
  </view>

  <view class="action-bar">
    <button class="btn btn-primary" bindtap="onImportExcel">导入Excel</button>
    <button class="btn btn-secondary" bindtap="onAddFabric">添加面料</button>
  </view>

  <view class="fabric-list">
    <view class="card" wx:for="{{fabrics}}" wx:key="_id" bindtap="goToDetail" data-id="{{item._id}}">
      <view class="fabric-header">
        <text class="fabric-code">{{item.new_code || item.code}}</text>
        <text class="fabric-type">{{item.type}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-info">
        <text>幅宽: {{item.width}}</text>
        <text>克重: {{item.weight}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-price">
        <text>版布价: {{item.sample_price_meter}}元/米</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-composition">{{item.composition}}</view>
    </view>
  </view>

  <view class="empty" wx:if="{{fabrics.length === 0 && !loading}}">
    <text>暂无面料数据，请先导入Excel</text>
  </view>

  <view class="loading" wx:if="{{loading}}">
    <text>加载中...</text>
  </view>
</view>
```

**Goal:** 构建一个极简的面料报价微信小程序，使用微信云开发，支持面料管理、报价生成和历史记录功能

**Architecture:** 采用微信云开发架构，前端使用微信小程序原生框架，后端使用微信云数据库和云函数

**Tech Stack:**
- 前端：微信小程序原生框架 (WXML + WXSS + JavaScript)
- 后端：微信云开发 (云数据库、云存储、云函数)
- 数据处理：xlsx库 (Excel解析)

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();

};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};

```html
<view class="container">
  <view class="search-bar">
    <input class="search-input" placeholder="搜索面料编号/名称" bindinput="onSearchInput" value="{{searchKeyword}}" />
    <button class="search-btn" bindtap="onSearch">搜索</button>
  </view>

  <view class="action-bar">
    <button class="btn btn-primary" bindtap="onImportExcel">导入Excel</button>
    <button class="btn btn-secondary" bindtap="onAddFabric">添加面料</button>
  </view>

  <view class="fabric-list">
    <view class="card" wx:for="{{fabrics}}" wx:key="_id" bindtap="goToDetail" data-id="{{item._id}}">
      <view class="fabric-header">
        <text class="fabric-code">{{item.new_code || item.code}}</text>
        <text class="fabric-type">{{item.type}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-info">
        <text>幅宽: {{item.width}}</text>
        <text>克重: {{item.weight}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-price">
        <text>版布价: {{item.sample_price_meter}}元/米</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-composition">{{item.composition}}</view>
    </view>
  </view>

  <view class="empty" wx:if="{{fabrics.length === 0 && !loading}}">
    <text>暂无面料数据，请先导入Excel</text>
  </view>

  <view class="loading" wx:if="{{loading}}">
    <text>加载中...</text>
  </view>
</view>
```

const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

```html
<view class="container">
  <view class="search-bar">
    <input class="search-input" placeholder="搜索面料编号/名称" bindinput="onSearchInput" value="{{searchKeyword}}" />
    <button class="search-btn" bindtap="onSearch">搜索</button>
  </view>

  <view class="action-bar">
    <button class="btn btn-primary" bindtap="onImportExcel">导入Excel</button>
    <button class="btn btn-secondary" bindtap="onAddFabric">添加面料</button>
  </view>

  <view class="fabric-list">
    <view class="card" wx:for="{{fabrics}}" wx:key="_id" bindtap="goToDetail" data-id="{{item._id}}">
      <view class="fabric-header">
        <text class="fabric-code">{{item.new_code || item.code}}</text>
        <text class="fabric-type">{{item.type}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-info">
        <text>幅宽: {{item.width}}</text>
        <text>克重: {{item.weight}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-price">
        <text>版布价: {{item.sample_price_meter}}元/米</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-composition">{{item.composition}}</view>
    </view>
  </view>

  <view class="empty" wx:if="{{fabrics.length === 0 && !loading}}">
    <text>暂无面料数据，请先导入Excel</text>
  </view>

  <view class="loading" wx:if="{{loading}}">
    <text>加载中...</text>
  </view>
</view>
```

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

```html
<view class="container">
  <view class="search-bar">
    <input class="search-input" placeholder="搜索面料编号/名称" bindinput="onSearchInput" value="{{searchKeyword}}" />
    <button class="search-btn" bindtap="onSearch">搜索</button>
  </view>

  <view class="action-bar">
    <button class="btn btn-primary" bindtap="onImportExcel">导入Excel</button>
    <button class="btn btn-secondary" bindtap="onAddFabric">添加面料</button>
  </view>

  <view class="fabric-list">
    <view class="card" wx:for="{{fabrics}}" wx:key="_id" bindtap="goToDetail" data-id="{{item._id}}">
      <view class="fabric-header">
        <text class="fabric-code">{{item.new_code || item.code}}</text>
        <text class="fabric-type">{{item.type}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-info">
        <text>幅宽: {{item.width}}</text>
        <text>克重: {{item.weight}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-price">
        <text>版布价: {{item.sample_price_meter}}元/米</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-composition">{{item.composition}}</view>
    </view>
  </view>

  <view class="empty" wx:if="{{fabrics.length === 0 && !loading}}">
    <text>暂无面料数据，请先导入Excel</text>
  </view>

  <view class="loading" wx:if="{{loading}}">
    <text>加载中...</text>
  </view>
</view>
```

**Goal:** 构建一个极简的面料报价微信小程序，使用微信云开发，支持面料管理、报价生成和历史记录功能

**Architecture:** 采用微信云开发架构，前端使用微信小程序原生框架，后端使用微信云数据库和云函数

**Tech Stack:**
- 前端：微信小程序原生框架 (WXML + WXSS + JavaScript)
- 后端：微信云开发 (云数据库、云存储、云函数)
- 数据处理：xlsx库 (Excel解析)

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

```html
<view class="container">
  <view class="search-bar">
    <input class="search-input" placeholder="搜索面料编号/名称" bindinput="onSearchInput" value="{{searchKeyword}}" />
    <button class="search-btn" bindtap="onSearch">搜索</button>
  </view>

  <view class="action-bar">
    <button class="btn btn-primary" bindtap="onImportExcel">导入Excel</button>
    <button class="btn btn-secondary" bindtap="onAddFabric">添加面料</button>
  </view>

  <view class="fabric-list">
    <view class="card" wx:for="{{fabrics}}" wx:key="_id" bindtap="goToDetail" data-id="{{item._id}}">
      <view class="fabric-header">
        <text class="fabric-code">{{item.new_code || item.code}}</text>
        <text class="fabric-type">{{item.type}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-info">
        <text>幅宽: {{item.width}}</text>
        <text>克重: {{item.weight}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-price">
        <text>版布价: {{item.sample_price_meter}}元/米</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-composition">{{item.composition}}</view>
    </view>
  </view>

  <view class="empty" wx:if="{{fabrics.length === 0 && !loading}}">
    <text>暂无面料数据，请先导入Excel</text>
  </view>

  <view class="loading" wx:if="{{loading}}">
    <text>加载中...</text>
  </view>
</view>
```

**Goal:** 构建一个极简的面料报价微信小程序，使用微信云开发，支持面料管理、报价生成和历史记录功能

**Architecture:** 采用微信云开发架构，前端使用微信小程序原生框架，后端使用微信云数据库和云函数

- 数据处理：xlsx库 (Excel解析)

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

```html
<view class="container">
  <view class="search-bar">
    <input class="search-input" placeholder="搜索面料编号/名称" bindinput="onSearchInput" value="{{searchKeyword}}" />
    <button class="search-btn" bindtap="onSearch">搜索</button>
  </view>

  <view class="action-bar">
    <button class="btn btn-primary" bindtap="onImportExcel">导入Excel</button>
    <button class="btn btn-secondary" bindtap="onAddFabric">添加面料</button>
  </view>

  <view class="fabric-list">
    <view class="card" wx:for="{{fabrics}}" wx:key="_id" bindtap="goToDetail" data-id="{{item._id}}">
      <view class="fabric-header">
        <text class="fabric-code">{{item.new_code || item.code}}</text>
        <text class="fabric-type">{{item.type}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-info">
        <text>幅宽: {{item.width}}</text>
        <text>克重: {{item.weight}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-price">
        <text>版布价: {{item.sample_price_meter}}元/米</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-composition">{{item.composition}}</view>
    </view>
  </view>

  <view class="empty" wx:if="{{fabrics.length === 0 && !loading}}">
    <text>暂无面料数据，请先导入Excel</text>
  </view>

  <view class="loading" wx:if="{{loading}}">
    <text>加载中...</text>
  </view>
</view>
```

**Goal:** 构建一个极简的面料报价微信小程序，使用微信云开发，支持面料管理、报价生成和历史记录功能

**Architecture:** 采用微信云开发架构，前端使用微信小程序原生框架，后端使用微信云数据库和云函数

- 前端：微信小程序原生框架 (WXML + WXSS + JavaScript)
- 后端：微信云开发 (云数据库、云存储、云函数)
- 数据处理：xlsx库 (Excel解析)

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

```html
<view class="container">
  <view class="search-bar">
    <input class="search-input" placeholder="搜索面料编号/名称" bindinput="onSearchInput" value="{{searchKeyword}}" />
    <button class="search-btn" bindtap="onSearch">搜索</button>
  </view>

  <view class="action-bar">
    <button class="btn btn-primary" bindtap="onImportExcel">导入Excel</button>
    <button class="btn btn-secondary" bindtap="onAddFabric">添加面料</button>
  </view>

  <view class="fabric-list">
    <view class="card" wx:for="{{fabrics}}" wx:key="_id" bindtap="goToDetail" data-id="{{item._id}}">
      <view class="fabric-header">
        <text class="fabric-code">{{item.new_code || item.code}}</text>
        <text class="fabric-type">{{item.type}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-info">
        <text>幅宽: {{item.width}}</text>
        <text>克重: {{item.weight}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-price">
        <text>版布价: {{item.sample_price_meter}}元/米</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-composition">{{item.composition}}</view>
    </view>
  </view>

  <view class="empty" wx:if="{{fabrics.length === 0 && !loading}}">
    <text>暂无面料数据，请先导入Excel</text>
  </view>

  <view class="loading" wx:if="{{loading}}">
    <text>加载中...</text>
  </view>
</view>
```

**Goal:** 构建一个极简的面料报价微信小程序，使用微信云开发，支持面料管理、报价生成和历史记录功能

**Architecture:** 采用微信云开发架构，前端使用微信小程序原生框架，后端使用微信云数据库和云函数

**Tech Stack:**
- 前端：微信小程序原生框架 (WXML + WXSS + JavaScript)
- 后端：微信云开发 (云数据库、云存储、云函数)
- 数据处理：xlsx库 (Excel解析)

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

```html
<view class="container">
  <view class="search-bar">
    <input class="search-input" placeholder="搜索面料编号/名称" bindinput="onSearchInput" value="{{searchKeyword}}" />
    <button class="search-btn" bindtap="onSearch">搜索</button>
  </view>

  <view class="action-bar">
    <button class="btn btn-primary" bindtap="onImportExcel">导入Excel</button>
    <button class="btn btn-secondary" bindtap="onAddFabric">添加面料</button>
  </view>

  <view class="fabric-list">
    <view class="card" wx:for="{{fabrics}}" wx:key="_id" bindtap="goToDetail" data-id="{{item._id}}">
      <view class="fabric-header">
        <text class="fabric-code">{{item.new_code || item.code}}</text>
        <text class="fabric-type">{{item.type}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-info">
        <text>幅宽: {{item.width}}</text>
        <text>克重: {{item.weight}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-price">
        <text>版布价: {{item.sample_price_meter}}元/米</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-composition">{{item.composition}}</view>
    </view>
  </view>

  <view class="empty" wx:if="{{fabrics.length === 0 && !loading}}">
    <text>暂无面料数据，请先导入Excel</text>
  </view>

  <view class="loading" wx:if="{{loading}}">
    <text>加载中...</text>
  </view>
</view>
```

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

```html
<view class="container">
  <view class="search-bar">
    <input class="search-input" placeholder="搜索面料编号/名称" bindinput="onSearchInput" value="{{searchKeyword}}" />
    <button class="search-btn" bindtap="onSearch">搜索</button>
  </view>

  <view class="action-bar">
    <button class="btn btn-primary" bindtap="onImportExcel">导入Excel</button>
    <button class="btn btn-secondary" bindtap="onAddFabric">添加面料</button>
  </view>

  <view class="fabric-list">
    <view class="card" wx:for="{{fabrics}}" wx:key="_id" bindtap="goToDetail" data-id="{{item._id}}">
      <view class="fabric-header">
        <text class="fabric-code">{{item.new_code || item.code}}</text>
        <text class="fabric-type">{{item.type}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-info">
        <text>幅宽: {{item.width}}</text>
        <text>克重: {{item.weight}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-price">
        <text>版布价: {{item.sample_price_meter}}元/米</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-composition">{{item.composition}}</view>
    </view>
  </view>

  <view class="empty" wx:if="{{fabrics.length === 0 && !loading}}">
    <text>暂无面料数据，请先导入Excel</text>
  </view>

  <view class="loading" wx:if="{{loading}}">
    <text>加载中...</text>
  </view>
</view>
```

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

- [ ] **Step 2: 创建index.wxml - 页面结构**

```html
<view class="container">
  <view class="search-bar">
    <input class="search-input" placeholder="搜索面料编号/名称" bindinput="onSearchInput" value="{{searchKeyword}}" />
    <button class="search-btn" bindtap="onSearch">搜索</button>
  </view>

  <view class="action-bar">
    <button class="btn btn-primary" bindtap="onImportExcel">导入Excel</button>
    <button class="btn btn-secondary" bindtap="onAddFabric">添加面料</button>
  </view>

  <view class="fabric-list">
    <view class="card" wx:for="{{fabrics}}" wx:key="_id" bindtap="goToDetail" data-id="{{item._id}}">
      <view class="fabric-header">
        <text class="fabric-code">{{item.new_code || item.code}}</text>
        <text class="fabric-type">{{item.type}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-info">
        <text>幅宽: {{item.width}}</text>
        <text>克重: {{item.weight}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-price">
        <text>版布价: {{item.sample_price_meter}}元/米</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-composition">{{item.composition}}</view>
    </view>
  </view>

  <view class="empty" wx:if="{{fabrics.length === 0 && !loading}}">
    <text>暂无面料数据，请先导入Excel</text>
  </view>

  <view class="loading" wx:if="{{loading}}">
    <text>加载中...</text>
  </view>
</view>
```

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

const formatTime = date => {

  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

};

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

**Goal:** 构建一个极简的面料报价微信小程序，使用微信云开发，支持面料管理、报价生成和历史记录功能

**Architecture:** 采用微信云开发架构，前端使用微信小程序原生框架，后端使用微信云数据库和云函数

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 创建index.js - 页面逻辑**

```javascript
const util = require('../../utils/util.js');
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabrics: [],
    searchKeyword: '',
    loading: false
  },

  onLoad: function () {
    this.loadFabrics();
  },

  onPullDownRefresh: function () {
    this.loadFabrics().then(() => {
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh();
    });
  },

  loadFabrics: function () {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    return db.collection('fabrics')
      .orderBy('create_time', 'desc')
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载面料失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onSearchInput: function (e) {
    this.setData({ searchKeyword: e.detail.value });
  },

  onSearch: function () {
    const keyword = this.data.searchKeyword.trim();
    if (!keyword) {
      this.loadFabrics();
      return;
    }

    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .where({
        $or: [
          { code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { new_code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { type: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) }
        ]
      })
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('搜索失败', err);
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onImportExcel: function () {
    wx.chooseMessageFile({
      count: 1,
      type: 'file',
      extension: ['xlsx', 'xls'],
      success: res => {
        const tempFilePath = res.tempFiles[0].path;
        this.uploadAndImportExcel(tempFilePath);
      }
    });
  },

**Goal:** 构建一个极简的面料报价微信小程序，使用微信云开发，支持面料管理、报价生成和历史记录功能

**Architecture:** 采用微信云开发架构，前端使用微信小程序原生框架，后端使用微信云数据库和云函数

**Tech Stack:**
- 前端：微信小程序原生框架 (WXML + WXSS + JavaScript)
- 后端：微信云开发 (云数据库、云存储、云函数)
- 数据处理：xlsx库 (Excel解析)

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

- [ ] **Step 2: 创建index.wxml - 页面结构**

```html
<view class="container">
  <view class="search-bar">
    <input class="search-input" placeholder="搜索面料编号/名称" bindinput="onSearchInput" value="{{searchKeyword}}" />
    <button class="search-btn" bindtap="onSearch">搜索</button>
  </view>

  <view class="action-bar">
    <button class="btn btn-primary" bindtap="onImportExcel">导入Excel</button>
    <button class="btn btn-secondary" bindtap="onAddFabric">添加面料</button>
  </view>

  <view class="fabric-list">
    <view class="card" wx:for="{{fabrics}}" wx:key="_id" bindtap="goToDetail" data-id="{{item._id}}">
      <view class="fabric-header">
        <text class="fabric-code">{{item.new_code || item.code}}</text>
        <text class="fabric-type">{{item.type}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-info">
        <text>幅宽: {{item.width}}</text>
        <text>克重: {{item.weight}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-price">
        <text>版布价: {{item.sample_price_meter}}元/米</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-composition">{{item.composition}}</view>
    </view>
  </view>

  <view class="empty" wx:if="{{fabrics.length === 0 && !loading}}">
    <text>暂无面料数据，请先导入Excel</text>
  </view>

  <view class="loading" wx:if="{{loading}}">
    <text>加载中...</text>
  </view>
</view>
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 创建index.js - 页面逻辑**

```javascript
const util = require('../../utils/util.js');
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabrics: [],
    searchKeyword: '',
    loading: false
  },

  onLoad: function () {
    this.loadFabrics();
  },

  onPullDownRefresh: function () {
    this.loadFabrics().then(() => {
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh();
    });
  },

  loadFabrics: function () {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    return db.collection('fabrics')
      .orderBy('create_time', 'desc')
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载面料失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onSearchInput: function (e) {
    this.setData({ searchKeyword: e.detail.value });
  },

  onSearch: function () {
    const keyword = this.data.searchKeyword.trim();
    if (!keyword) {
      this.loadFabrics();
      return;
    }

    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .where({
        $or: [
          { code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { new_code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { type: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) }
        ]
      })
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('搜索失败', err);
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onImportExcel: function () {
    wx.chooseMessageFile({
      count: 1,
      type: 'file',
      extension: ['xlsx', 'xls'],
      success: res => {
        const tempFilePath = res.tempFiles[0].path;
        this.uploadAndImportExcel(tempFilePath);
      }
    });
  },

  uploadAndImportExcel: function (filePath) {
    wx.showLoading({ title: '导入中...' });
    
    wx.cloud.uploadFile({
      cloudPath: 'excel-import/' + Date.now() + '.xlsx',
      filePath: filePath,
      success: uploadRes =># 面料报价微信小程序 - 轻量化实施计划

**Goal:** 构建一个极简的面料报价微信小程序，使用微信云开发，支持面料管理、报价生成和历史记录功能

**Architecture:** 采用微信云开发架构，前端使用微信小程序原生框架，后端使用微信云数据库和云函数

**Tech Stack:**
- 前端：微信小程序原生框架 (WXML + WXSS + JavaScript)
- 后端：微信云开发 (云数据库、云存储、云函数)
- 数据处理：xlsx库 (Excel解析)

**Goal:** 构建一个极简的面料报价微信小程序，使用微信云开发，支持面料管理、报价生成和历史记录功能

**Architecture:** 采用微信云开发架构，前端使用微信小程序原生框架，后端使用微信云数据库和云函数

**Tech Stack:**
- 前端：微信小程序原生框架 (WXML + WXSS + JavaScript)
- 后端：微信云开发 (云数据库、云存储、云函数)
- 数据处理：xlsx库 (Excel解析)

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

```html
<view class="container">
  <view class="search-bar">
    <input class="search-input" placeholder="搜索面料编号/名称" bindinput="onSearchInput" value="{{searchKeyword}}" />
    <button class="search-btn" bindtap="onSearch">搜索</button>
  </view>

  <view class="action-bar">
    <button class="btn btn-primary" bindtap="onImportExcel">导入Excel</button>
    <button class="btn btn-secondary" bindtap="onAddFabric">添加面料</button>
  </view>

  <view class="fabric-list">
    <view class="card" wx:for="{{fabrics}}" wx:key="_id" bindtap="goToDetail" data-id="{{item._id}}">
      <view class="fabric-header">
        <text class="fabric-code">{{item.new_code || item.code}}</text>
        <text class="fabric-type">{{item.type}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-info">
        <text>幅宽: {{item.width}}</text>
        <text>克重: {{item.weight}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-price">
        <text>版布价: {{item.sample_price_meter}}元/米</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-composition">{{item.composition}}</view>
    </view>
  </view>

  <view class="empty" wx:if="{{fabrics.length === 0 && !loading}}">
    <text>暂无面料数据，请先导入Excel</text>
  </view>

  <view class="loading" wx:if="{{loading}}">
    <text>加载中...</text>
  </view>
</view>
```

**Goal:** 构建一个极简的面料报价微信小程序，使用微信云开发，支持面料管理、报价生成和历史记录功能

**Architecture:** 采用微信云开发架构，前端使用微信小程序原生框架，后端使用微信云数据库和云函数

**Tech Stack:**
- 前端：微信小程序原生框架 (WXML + WXSS + JavaScript)
- 后端：微信云开发 (云数据库、云存储、云函数)
- 数据处理：xlsx库 (Excel解析)

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

**Goal:** 构建一个极简的面料报价微信小程序，使用微信云开发，支持面料管理、报价生成和历史记录功能

**Architecture:** 采用微信云开发架构，前端使用微信小程序原生框架，后端使用微信云数据库和云函数

**Tech Stack:**
- 前端：微信小程序原生框架 (WXML + WXSS + JavaScript)
- 后端：微信云开发 (云数据库、云存储、云函数)
- 数据处理：xlsx库 (Excel解析)

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

```javascript
const util = require('../../utils/util.js');
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabrics: [],
    searchKeyword: '',
    loading: false
  },

  onLoad: function () {
    this.loadFabrics();
  },

  onPullDownRefresh: function () {
    this.loadFabrics().then(() => {
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh();
    });
  },

  loadFabrics: function () {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    return db.collection('fabrics')
      .orderBy('create_time', 'desc')
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载面料失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onSearchInput: function (e) {
    this.setData({ searchKeyword: e.detail.value });
  },

  onSearch: function () {
    const keyword = this.data.searchKeyword.trim();
    if (!keyword) {
      this.loadFabrics();
      return;
    }

    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .where({
        $or: [
          { code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { new_code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { type: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) }
        ]
      })
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('搜索失败', err);
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onImportExcel: function () {
    wx.chooseMessageFile({
      count: 1,
      type: 'file',
      extension: ['xlsx', 'xls'],
      success: res => {
        const tempFilePath = res.tempFiles[0].path;
        this.uploadAndImportExcel(tempFilePath);
      }
    });
  },

  uploadAndImportExcel: function (filePath) {
    wx.showLoading({ title: '导入中...' });
    
    wx.cloud.uploadFile({
      cloudPath: 'excel-import/' + Date.now() + '.xlsx',
      filePath: filePath,
      success: uploadRes => {
        wx.cloud.callFunction({
          name: 'importExcel',
          data: { fileID: uploadRes.fileID },
          success: importRes => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            if (importRes.result.success) {
              wx.showToast({
                title: `成功导入${importRes.result.count}条数据`,
                icon: 'success'
              });
              this.loadFabrics();
            } else {
              wx.showToast({
                title: importRes.result.message || '导入失败',
                icon:# 面料报价微信小程序 - 轻量化实施计划

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** 构建一个极简的面料报价微信小程序，使用微信云开发，支持面料管理、报价生成和历史记录功能

**Architecture:** 采用微信云开发架构，前端使用微信小程序原生框架，后端使用微信云数据库和云函数

**Tech Stack:**
- 前端：微信小程序原生框架 (WXML + WXSS + JavaScript)
- 后端：微信云开发 (云数据库、云存储、云函数)
- 数据处理：xlsx库 (Excel解析)

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** 构建一个极简的面料报价微信小程序，使用微信云开发，支持面料管理、报价生成和历史记录功能

**Architecture:** 采用微信云开发架构，前端使用微信小程序原生框架，后端使用微信云数据库和云函数

**Tech Stack:**
- 前端：微信小程序原生框架 (WXML + WXSS + JavaScript)
- 后端：微信云开发 (云数据库、云存储、云函数)
- 数据处理：xlsx库 (Excel解析)

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```
