- [ ] **Step 4: 创建index.js - 页面逻辑**

```javascript
const util = require('../../utils/util.js');
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabrics: [],
    searchKeyword: '',
    loading: false
  },

  onLoad: function () {
    this.loadFabrics();
  },

  onPullDownRefresh: function () {
    this.loadFabrics().then(() => {
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh();
    });
  },

  loadFabrics: function () {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    return db.collection('fabrics')
      .orderBy('create_time', 'desc')
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载面料失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onSearchInput: function (e) {
    this.setData({ searchKeyword: e.detail.value });
  },

  onSearch: function () {
    const keyword = this.data.searchKeyword.trim();
    if (!keyword) {
      this.loadFabrics();
      return;
    }

    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .where({
        $or: [
          { code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { new_code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { type: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) }
        ]
      })
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('搜索失败', err);
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

    wx.chooseMessageFile({
      count: 1,
      type: 'file',
      extension: ['xlsx', 'xls'],
      success: res => {
        const tempFilePath = res.tempFiles[0].path;
        this.uploadAndImportExcel(tempFilePath);
      }
    });
  },

    wx.showLoading({ title: '导入中...' });

      filePath: filePath,
      success: uploadRes => {
        wx.cloud.callFunction({
          name: 'importExcel',
          data: { fileID: uploadRes.fileID },
          success: importRes => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            if (importRes.result.success) {
              wx.showToast({
                title: `成功导入${importRes.result.count}条数据`,
                icon: 'success'
              });
              this.loadFabrics();
            } else {
              wx.showToast({
                title: importRes.result.message || '导入失败',
                icon: 'none'
              });
            }
          },
          fail: err => {

            console.error('导入失败', err);

```javascript
const util = require('../../utils/util.js');
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabrics: [],
    searchKeyword: '',
    loading: false
  },

  onLoad: function () {
    this.loadFabrics();
  },

  onPullDownRefresh: function () {
    this.loadFabrics().then(() => {
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh();
    });
  },

  loadFabrics: function () {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    return db.collection('fabrics')
      .orderBy('create_time', 'desc')
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载面料失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onSearchInput: function (e) {
    this.setData({ searchKeyword: e.detail.value });
  },

  onSearch: function () {
    const keyword = this.data.searchKeyword.trim();
    if (!keyword) {
      this.loadFabrics();
      return;
    }

    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .where({
        $or: [
          { code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { new_code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { type: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) }
        ]
      })
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('搜索失败', err);
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onImportExcel: function () {
    wx.chooseMessageFile({
      count: 1,
      type: 'file',
      extension: ['xlsx', 'xls'],
      success: res => {
        const tempFilePath = res.tempFiles[0].path;
        this.uploadAndImportExcel(tempFilePath);
      }
    });
  },

  uploadAndImportExcel: function (filePath) {
    wx.showLoading({ title: '导入中...' });
    
    wx.cloud.uploadFile({
      cloudPath: 'excel-import/' + Date.now() + '.xlsx',
      filePath: filePath,
      success: uploadRes => {
        wx.cloud.callFunction({
          name: 'importExcel',
          data: { fileID: uploadRes.fileID },
          success: importRes => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            if (importRes.result.success) {
              wx.showToast({
                title: `成功导入${importRes.result.count}条数据`,
                icon: 'success'
              });
              this.loadFabrics();
            } else {
              wx.showToast({
                title: importRes.result.message || '导入失败',
                icon: 'none'
              });
            }
          },
          fail: err => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            console.error('导入失败', err);
            wx.showToast({
              title: '导入失败',
              icon: 'none'
            });
# 面料报价微信小程序 - 轻量化实施计划

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** 构建一个极简的面料报价微信小程序，使用微信云开发，支持面料管理、报价生成和历史记录功能

**Architecture:** 采用微信云开发架构，前端使用微信小程序原生框架，后端使用微信云数据库和云函数

**Tech Stack:**
- 前端：微信小程序原生框架 (WXML + WXSS + JavaScript)
- 后端：微信云开发 (云数据库、云存储、云函数)
- 数据处理：xlsx库 (Excel解析)

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

```javascript
const util = require('../../utils/util.js');
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabrics: [],
    searchKeyword: '',
    loading: false
  },

  onLoad: function () {
    this.loadFabrics();
  },

  onPullDownRefresh: function () {
    this.loadFabrics().then(() => {
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh();
    });
  },

  loadFabrics: function () {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    return db.collection('fabrics')
      .orderBy('create_time', 'desc')
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载面料失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onSearchInput: function (e) {
    this.setData({ searchKeyword: e.detail.value });
  },

  onSearch: function () {
    const keyword = this.data.searchKeyword.trim();
    if (!keyword) {
      this.loadFabrics();
      return;
    }

    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .where({
        $or: [
          { code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { new_code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { type: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) }
        ]
      })
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('搜索失败', err);
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onImportExcel: function () {
    wx.chooseMessageFile({
      count: 1,
      type: 'file',
      extension: ['xlsx', 'xls'],
      success: res => {
        const tempFilePath = res.tempFiles[0].path;
        this.uploadAndImportExcel(tempFilePath);
      }
    });
  },

  uploadAndImportExcel: function (filePath) {
    wx.showLoading({ title: '导入中...' });
    
    wx.cloud.uploadFile({
      cloudPath: 'excel-import/' + Date.now() + '.xlsx',
      filePath: filePath,
      success: uploadRes => {
        wx.cloud.callFunction({
          name: 'importExcel',
          data: { fileID: uploadRes.fileID },
          success: importRes => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            if (importRes.result.success) {
              wx.showToast({
                title: `成功导入${importRes.result.count}条数据`,
                icon: 'success'
              });
              this.loadFabrics();
            } else {

                title: importRes.result.message || '导入失败',

              });
            }

              title: '导入失败',
              icon: 'none'
            });
          }
        });
      },

**Goal:** 构建一个极简的面料报价微信小程序，使用微信云开发，支持面料管理、报价生成和历史记录功能

**Architecture:** 采用微信云开发架构，前端使用微信小程序原生框架，后端使用微信云数据库和云函数

**Tech Stack:**
- 前端：微信小程序原生框架 (WXML + WXSS + JavaScript)
- 后端：微信云开发 (云数据库、云存储、云函数)
- 数据处理：xlsx库 (Excel解析)

**Goal:** 构建一个极简的面料报价微信小程序，使用微信云开发，支持面料管理、报价生成和历史记录功能

**Architecture:** 采用微信云开发架构，前端使用微信小程序原生框架，后端使用微信云数据库和云函数

**Tech Stack:**
- 前端：微信小程序原生框架 (WXML + WXSS + JavaScript)
- 后端：微信云开发 (云数据库、云存储、云函数)
- 数据处理：xlsx库 (Excel解析)

---

## 文件结构映射

```
fabric-quotation/
├── miniprogram/
│   ├── app.js
│   ├── app.json
│   ├── app.wxss
│   ├── project.config.json
│   ├── pages/
│   │   ├── index/          # 首页/面料列表
│   │   ├── fabric-detail/ # 面料详情
│   │   ├── fabric-edit/   # 面料编辑
│   │   ├── quotation/     # 新建报价
│   │   └── history/       # 报价历史
│   └── utils/
│       └── util.js
├── cloudfunctions/
│   └── importExcel/       # Excel导入云函数
│       ├── index.js
│       └── package.json
└── docs/
```

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

```html
<view class="container">
  <view class="search-bar">
    <input class="search-input" placeholder="搜索面料编号/名称" bindinput="onSearchInput" value="{{searchKeyword}}" />
    <button class="search-btn" bindtap="onSearch">搜索</button>
  </view>

  <view class="action-bar">
    <button class="btn btn-primary" bindtap="onImportExcel">导入Excel</button>
    <button class="btn btn-secondary" bindtap="onAddFabric">添加面料</button>
  </view>

  <view class="fabric-list">
    <view class="card" wx:for="{{fabrics}}" wx:key="_id" bindtap="goToDetail" data-id="{{item._id}}">
      <view class="fabric-header">
        <text class="fabric-code">{{item.new_code || item.code}}</text>
        <text class="fabric-type">{{item.type}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-info">
        <text>幅宽: {{item.width}}</text>
        <text>克重: {{item.weight}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-price">
        <text>版布价: {{item.sample_price_meter}}元/米</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-composition">{{item.composition}}</view>
    </view>
  </view>

  <view class="empty" wx:if="{{fabrics.length === 0 && !loading}}">
    <text>暂无面料数据，请先导入Excel</text>
  </view>

  <view class="loading" wx:if="{{loading}}">
    <text>加载中...</text>
  </view>
</view>
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 创建index.js - 页面逻辑**

```javascript
const util = require('../../utils/util.js');
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabrics: [],
    searchKeyword: '',
    loading: false
  },

  onLoad: function () {
    this.loadFabrics();
  },

  onPullDownRefresh: function () {
    this.loadFabrics().then(() => {
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh();
    });
  },

  loadFabrics: function () {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    return db.collection('fabrics')
      .orderBy('create_time', 'desc')
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载面料失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onSearchInput: function (e) {
    this.setData({ searchKeyword: e.detail.value });
  },

  onSearch: function () {
    const keyword = this.data.searchKeyword.trim();
    if (!keyword) {
      this.loadFabrics();
      return;
    }

    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .where({
        $or: [
          { code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { new_code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { type: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) }
        ]
      })
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('搜索失败', err);
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onImportExcel: function () {
    wx.chooseMessageFile({
      count: 1,
      type: 'file',
      extension: ['xlsx', 'xls'],
      success: res => {
        const tempFilePath = res.tempFiles[0].path;
        this.uploadAndImportExcel(tempFilePath);
      }
    });
  },

  uploadAndImportExcel: function (filePath) {
    wx.showLoading({ title: '导入中...' });
    
    wx.cloud.uploadFile({
      cloudPath: 'excel-import/' + Date.now() + '.xlsx',
      filePath: filePath,
      success: uploadRes => {
        wx.cloud.callFunction({
          name: 'importExcel',
          data: { fileID: uploadRes.fileID },
          success: importRes => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            if (importRes.result.success) {
              wx.showToast({
                title: `成功导入${importRes.result.count}条数据`,
                icon: 'success'
              });
              this.loadFabrics();
            } else {
              wx.showToast({
                title: importRes.result.message || '导入失败',
                icon: 'none'
              });
            }
          },
          fail: err => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            console.error('导入失败', err);
            wx.showToast({
              title: '导入失败',
              icon: 'none'
            });
          }
        });
      },
      fail: err => {
        wx.hideLoading();
        console.error('上传失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '上传失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
      }
    });
  },

- [ ] **Step 4: 创建index.js - 页面逻辑**

```javascript
const util = require('../../utils/util.js');
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabrics: [],
    searchKeyword: '',
    loading: false
  },

  onLoad: function () {
    this.loadFabrics();
  },

  onPullDownRefresh: function () {
    this.loadFabrics().then(() => {
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh();
    });
  },

  loadFabrics: function () {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    return db.collection('fabrics')
      .orderBy('create_time', 'desc')
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载面料失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onSearchInput: function (e) {
    this.setData({ searchKeyword: e.detail.value });
  },

  onSearch: function () {
    const keyword = this.data.searchKeyword.trim();
    if (!keyword) {
      this.loadFabrics();
      return;
    }

    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .where({
        $or: [
          { code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { new_code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { type: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) }
        ]
      })
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('搜索失败', err);
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onImportExcel: function () {
    wx.chooseMessageFile({
      count: 1,
      type: 'file',
      extension: ['xlsx', 'xls'],
      success: res => {
        const tempFilePath = res.tempFiles[0].path;
        this.uploadAndImportExcel(tempFilePath);
      }
    });
  },

  uploadAndImportExcel: function (filePath) {
    wx.showLoading({ title: '导入中...' });
    
    wx.cloud.uploadFile({
      cloudPath: 'excel-import/' + Date.now() + '.xlsx',
      filePath: filePath,
      success: uploadRes => {
        wx.cloud.callFunction({
          name: 'importExcel',
          data: { fileID: uploadRes.fileID },
          success: importRes => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            if (importRes.result.success) {
              wx.showToast({
                title: `成功导入${importRes.result.count}条数据`,
                icon: 'success'
              });
              this.loadFabrics();
            } else {
              wx.showToast({
                title: importRes.result.message || '导入失败',
                icon: 'none'
              });
            }
          },
          fail: err => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            console.error('导入失败', err);
            wx.showToast({
              title: '导入失败',
              icon: 'none'
            });
          }
        });
      },
      fail: err => {
        wx.hideLoading();
        console.error('上传失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '上传失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
      }
    });
  },

  onAddFabric: function () {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: '/pages/fabric-edit/fabric-edit'
    });
  },

# 面料报价微信小程序 - 轻量化实施计划

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** 构建一个极简的面料报价微信小程序，使用微信云开发，支持面料管理、报价生成和历史记录功能

**Architecture:** 采用微信云开发架构，前端使用微信小程序原生框架，后端使用微信云数据库和云函数

**Tech Stack:**
- 前端：微信小程序原生框架 (WXML + WXSS + JavaScript)
- 后端：微信云开发 (云数据库、云存储、云函数)
- 数据处理：xlsx库 (Excel解析)

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

```html
<view class="container">
  <view class="search-bar">
    <input class="search-input" placeholder="搜索面料编号/名称" bindinput="onSearchInput" value="{{searchKeyword}}" />
    <button class="search-btn" bindtap="onSearch">搜索</button>
  </view>

  <view class="action-bar">
    <button class="btn btn-primary" bindtap="onImportExcel">导入Excel</button>
    <button class="btn btn-secondary" bindtap="onAddFabric">添加面料</button>
  </view>

  <view class="fabric-list">
    <view class="card" wx:for="{{fabrics}}" wx:key="_id" bindtap="goToDetail" data-id="{{item._id}}">
      <view class="fabric-header">
        <text class="fabric-code">{{item.new_code || item.code}}</text>
        <text class="fabric-type">{{item.type}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-info">
        <text>幅宽: {{item.width}}</text>
        <text>克重: {{item.weight}}</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-price">
        <text>版布价: {{item.sample_price_meter}}元/米</text>
      </view>
      <view class="fabric-composition">{{item.composition}}</view>
    </view>
  </view>

  <view class="empty" wx:if="{{fabrics.length === 0 && !loading}}">
    <text>暂无面料数据，请先导入Excel</text>
  </view>

  <view class="loading" wx:if="{{loading}}">
    <text>加载中...</text>
  </view>
</view>

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 创建index.js - 页面逻辑**

```javascript
const util = require('../../utils/util.js');
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabrics: [],
    searchKeyword: '',
    loading: false
  },

  onLoad: function () {
    this.loadFabrics();
  },

  onPullDownRefresh: function () {
    this.loadFabrics().then(() => {
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh();
    });
  },

  loadFabrics: function () {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    return db.collection('fabrics')
      .orderBy('create_time', 'desc')
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载面料失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onSearchInput: function (e) {
    this.setData({ searchKeyword: e.detail.value });
  },

  onSearch: function () {
    const keyword = this.data.searchKeyword.trim();
    if (!keyword) {
      this.loadFabrics();
      return;
    }

    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .where({
        $or: [
          { code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { new_code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { type: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) }
        ]
      })
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('搜索失败', err);
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onImportExcel: function () {
    wx.chooseMessageFile({
      count: 1,
      type: 'file',
      extension: ['xlsx', 'xls'],
      success: res => {
        const tempFilePath = res.tempFiles[0].path;
        this.uploadAndImportExcel(tempFilePath);
      }
    });
  },

  uploadAndImportExcel: function (filePath) {
    wx.showLoading({ title: '导入中...' });
    
    wx.cloud.uploadFile({
      cloudPath: 'excel-import/' + Date.now() + '.xlsx',
      filePath: filePath,
      success: uploadRes => {
        wx.cloud.callFunction({
          name: 'importExcel',
          data: { fileID: uploadRes.fileID },
          success: importRes => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            if (importRes.result.success) {
              wx.showToast({
                title: `成功导入${importRes.result.count}条数据`,
                icon: 'success'
              });
              this.loadFabrics();
            } else {
              wx.showToast({
                title: importRes.result.message || '导入失败',
                icon: 'none'
              });
            }
          },
          fail: err => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            console.error('导入失败', err);
            wx.showToast({
              title: '导入失败',
              icon: 'none'
            });
          }
        });
      },
      fail: err => {
        wx.hideLoading();
        console.error('上传失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '上传失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
      }
    });
  },

  onAddFabric: function () {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: '/pages/fabric-edit/fabric-edit'
    });
  },

  goToDetail: function (e) {
    const id = e.currentTarget.dataset.id;
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/fabric-detail/fabric-detail?id# 面料报价微信小程序 - 轻量化实施计划

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 创建index.js - 页面逻辑**

```javascript
const util = require('../../utils/util.js');
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabrics: [],
    searchKeyword: '',
    loading: false
  },

  onLoad: function () {
    this.loadFabrics();
  },

  onPullDownRefresh: function () {
    this.loadFabrics().then(() => {
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh();
    });
  },

  loadFabrics: function () {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    return db.collection('fabrics')
      .orderBy('create_time', 'desc')
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载面料失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onSearchInput: function (e) {
    this.setData({ searchKeyword: e.detail.value });
  },

  onSearch: function () {
    const keyword = this.data.searchKeyword.trim();
    if (!keyword) {
      this.loadFabrics();
      return;
    }

    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .where({
        $or: [
          { code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { new_code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { type: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) }
        ]
      })
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('搜索失败', err);
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onImportExcel: function () {
    wx.chooseMessageFile({
      count: 1,
      type: 'file',
      extension: ['xlsx', 'xls'],
      success: res => {
        const tempFilePath = res.tempFiles[0].path;
        this.uploadAndImportExcel(tempFilePath);
      }
    });
  },

  uploadAndImportExcel: function (filePath) {
    wx.showLoading({ title: '导入中...' });
    
    wx.cloud.uploadFile({
      cloudPath: 'excel-import/' + Date.now() + '.xlsx',
      filePath: filePath,
      success: uploadRes => {
        wx.cloud.callFunction({
          name: 'importExcel',
          data: { fileID: uploadRes.fileID },
          success: importRes => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            if (importRes.result.success) {
              wx.showToast({
                title: `成功导入${importRes.result.count}条数据`,
                icon: 'success'
              });
              this.loadFabrics();
            } else {
              wx.showToast({
                title: importRes.result.message || '导入失败',
                icon: 'none'
              });
            }
          },
          fail: err => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            console.error('导入失败', err);
            wx.showToast({
              title: '导入失败',
              icon: 'none'
            });
          }
        });
      },
      fail: err => {
        wx.hideLoading();
        console.error('上传失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '上传失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
      }
    });
  },

  onAddFabric: function () {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: '/pages/fabric-edit/fabric-edit'
    });
  },

  goToDetail: function (e) {
    const id = e.currentTarget.dataset.id;
    wx.navigateTo({

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 创建index.js - 页面逻辑**

```javascript
const util = require('../../utils/util.js');
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabrics: [],
    searchKeyword: '',
    loading: false
  },

  onLoad: function () {
    this.loadFabrics();
  },

  onPullDownRefresh: function () {
    this.loadFabrics().then(() => {
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh();
    });
  },

  loadFabrics: function () {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    return db.collection('fabrics')
      .orderBy('create_time', 'desc')
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载面料失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onSearchInput: function (e) {
    this.setData({ searchKeyword: e.detail.value });
  },

  onSearch: function () {
    const keyword = this.data.searchKeyword.trim();
    if (!keyword) {
      this.loadFabrics();
      return;
    }

    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .where({
        $or: [
          { code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { new_code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { type: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) }
        ]
      })
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('搜索失败', err);
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onImportExcel: function () {
    wx.chooseMessageFile({
      count: 1,
      type: 'file',
      extension: ['xlsx', 'xls'],
      success: res => {
        const tempFilePath = res.tempFiles[0].path;
        this.uploadAndImportExcel(tempFilePath);
      }
    });
  },

  uploadAndImportExcel: function (filePath) {
    wx.showLoading({ title: '导入中...' });
    
    wx.cloud.uploadFile({
      cloudPath: 'excel-import/' + Date.now() + '.xlsx',
      filePath: filePath,
      success: uploadRes => {
        wx.cloud.callFunction({
          name: 'importExcel',
          data: { fileID: uploadRes.fileID },
          success: importRes => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            if (importRes.result.success) {
              wx.showToast({
                title: `成功导入${importRes.result.count}条数据`,
                icon: 'success'
              });
              this.loadFabrics();
            } else {
              wx.showToast({
                title: importRes.result.message || '导入失败',
                icon: 'none'
              });
            }
          },
          fail: err => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            console.error('导入失败', err);
            wx.showToast({
              title: '导入失败',
              icon: 'none'
            });
          }
        });
      },
      fail: err => {
        wx.hideLoading();
        console.error('上传失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '上传失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
      }
    });
  },

  onAddFabric: function () {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: '/pages/fabric-edit/fabric-edit'
    });
  },

  goToDetail: function (e) {
    const id = e.currentTarget.dataset.id;
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/fabric-detail/fabric-detail?id=${id}`
    });
  }
});
```

const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};

- [ ] **Step 4: 创建index.js - 页面逻辑**

```javascript
const util = require('../../utils/util.js');
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabrics: [],
    searchKeyword: '',
    loading: false
  },

  onLoad: function () {
    this.loadFabrics();
  },

  onPullDownRefresh: function () {
    this.loadFabrics().then(() => {
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh();
    });
  },

  loadFabrics: function () {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    return db.collection('fabrics')
      .orderBy('create_time', 'desc')
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载面料失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onSearchInput: function (e) {
    this.setData({ searchKeyword: e.detail.value });
  },

  onSearch: function () {
    const keyword = this.data.searchKeyword.trim();
    if (!keyword) {
      this.loadFabrics();
      return;
    }

    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .where({
        $or: [
          { code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { new_code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { type: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) }
        ]
      })
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('搜索失败', err);
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onImportExcel: function () {
    wx.chooseMessageFile({
      count: 1,
      type: 'file',
      extension: ['xlsx', 'xls'],
      success: res => {
        const tempFilePath = res.tempFiles[0].path;
        this.uploadAndImportExcel(tempFilePath);
      }
    });
  },

  uploadAndImportExcel: function (filePath) {
    wx.showLoading({ title: '导入中...' });
    
    wx.cloud.uploadFile({
      cloudPath: 'excel-import/' + Date.now() + '.xlsx',
      filePath: filePath,
      success: uploadRes => {
        wx.cloud.callFunction({
          name: 'importExcel',
          data: { fileID: uploadRes.fileID },
          success: importRes => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            if (importRes.result.success) {
              wx.showToast({
                title: `成功导入${importRes.result.count}条数据`,
                icon: 'success'
              });
              this.loadFabrics();
            } else {
              wx.showToast({
                title: importRes.result.message || '导入失败',
                icon: 'none'
              });
            }
          },
          fail: err => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            console.error('导入失败', err);
            wx.showToast({
              title: '导入失败',
              icon: 'none'
            });
          }
        });
      },
      fail: err => {
        wx.hideLoading();
        console.error('上传失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '上传失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
      }
    });
  },

  onAddFabric: function () {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: '/pages/fabric-edit/fabric-edit'
    });
  },

  goToDetail: function (e) {
    const id = e.currentTarget.dataset.id;
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/fabric-detail/fabric-detail?id=${id}`
    });
  }
});
```

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 创建index.js - 页面逻辑**

```javascript
const util = require('../../utils/util.js');
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabrics: [],
    searchKeyword: '',
    loading: false
  },

  onLoad: function () {
    this.loadFabrics();
  },

  onPullDownRefresh: function () {
    this.loadFabrics().then(() => {
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh();
    });
  },

  loadFabrics: function () {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    return db.collection('fabrics')
      .orderBy('create_time', 'desc')
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载面料失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onSearchInput: function (e) {
    this.setData({ searchKeyword: e.detail.value });
  },

  onSearch: function () {
    const keyword = this.data.searchKeyword.trim();
    if (!keyword) {
      this.loadFabrics();
      return;
    }

    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .where({
        $or: [
          { code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { new_code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { type: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) }
        ]
      })
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('搜索失败', err);
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onImportExcel: function () {
    wx.chooseMessageFile({
      count: 1,
      type: 'file',
      extension: ['xlsx', 'xls'],
      success: res => {
        const tempFilePath = res.tempFiles[0].path;
        this.uploadAndImportExcel(tempFilePath);
      }
    });
  },

  uploadAndImportExcel: function (filePath) {
    wx.showLoading({ title: '导入中...' });
    
    wx.cloud.uploadFile({
      cloudPath: 'excel-import/' + Date.now() + '.xlsx',
      filePath: filePath,
      success: uploadRes => {
        wx.cloud.callFunction({
          name: 'importExcel',
          data: { fileID: uploadRes.fileID },
          success: importRes => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            if (importRes.result.success) {
              wx.showToast({
                title: `成功导入${importRes.result.count}条数据`,
                icon: 'success'
              });
              this.loadFabrics();
            } else {
              wx.showToast({
                title: importRes.result.message || '导入失败',
                icon: 'none'
              });
            }
          },
          fail: err => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            console.error('导入失败', err);
            wx.showToast({
              title: '导入失败',
              icon: 'none'
            });
          }
        });
      },
      fail: err => {
        wx.hideLoading();
        console.error('上传失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '上传失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
      }
    });
  },

  onAddFabric: function () {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: '/pages/fabric-edit/fabric-edit'
    });
  },

  goToDetail: function (e) {
    const id = e.currentTarget.dataset.id;
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/fabric-detail/fabric-detail?id=${id}`
    });
  }
});
```

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 创建index.js - 页面逻辑**

```javascript
const util = require('../../utils/util.js');
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabrics: [],
    searchKeyword: '',
    loading: false
  },

  onLoad: function () {
    this.loadFabrics();
  },

  onPullDownRefresh: function () {
    this.loadFabrics().then(() => {
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh();
    });
  },

  loadFabrics: function () {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    return db.collection('fabrics')
      .orderBy('create_time', 'desc')
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载面料失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onSearchInput: function (e) {
    this.setData({ searchKeyword: e.detail.value });
  },

  onSearch: function () {
    const keyword = this.data.searchKeyword.trim();
    if (!keyword) {
      this.loadFabrics();
      return;
    }

    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .where({
        $or: [
          { code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { new_code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { type: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) }
        ]
      })
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('搜索失败', err);
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onImportExcel: function () {
    wx.chooseMessageFile({
      count: 1,
      type: 'file',
      extension: ['xlsx', 'xls'],
      success: res => {
        const tempFilePath = res.tempFiles[0].path;
        this.uploadAndImportExcel(tempFilePath);
      }
    });
  },

  uploadAndImportExcel: function (filePath) {
    wx.showLoading({ title: '导入中...' });
    
    wx.cloud.uploadFile({
      cloudPath: 'excel-import/' + Date.now() + '.xlsx',
      filePath: filePath,
      success: uploadRes => {
        wx.cloud.callFunction({
          name: 'importExcel',
          data: { fileID: uploadRes.fileID },
          success: importRes => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            if (importRes.result.success) {
              wx.showToast({
                title: `成功导入${importRes.result.count}条数据`,
                icon: 'success'
              });
              this.loadFabrics();
            } else {
              wx.showToast({
                title: importRes.result.message || '导入失败',
                icon: 'none'
              });
            }
          },
          fail: err => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            console.error('导入失败', err);
            wx.showToast({
              title: '导入失败',
              icon: 'none'
            });
          }
        });
      },
      fail: err => {
        wx.hideLoading();
        console.error('上传失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '上传失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
      }
    });
  },

  onAddFabric: function () {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: '/pages/fabric-edit/fabric-edit'
    });
  },

  goToDetail: function (e) {
    const id = e.currentTarget.dataset.id;
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/fabric-detail/fabric-detail?id=${id}`
    });
  }
});
```

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** 构建一个极简的面料报价微信小程序，使用微信云开发，支持面料管理、报价生成和历史记录功能

**Architecture:** 采用微信云开发架构，前端使用微信小程序原生框架，后端使用微信云数据库和云函数

**Tech Stack:**
- 前端：微信小程序原生框架 (WXML + WXSS + JavaScript)
- 后端：微信云开发 (云数据库、云存储、云函数)
- 数据处理：xlsx库 (Excel解析)

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 创建index.js - 页面逻辑**

```javascript
const util = require('../../utils/util.js');
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabrics: [],
    searchKeyword: '',
    loading: false
  },

  onLoad: function () {
    this.loadFabrics();
  },

  onPullDownRefresh: function () {
    this.loadFabrics().then(() => {
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh();
    });
  },

  loadFabrics: function () {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    return db.collection('fabrics')
      .orderBy('create_time', 'desc')
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载面料失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onSearchInput: function (e) {
    this.setData({ searchKeyword: e.detail.value });
  },

  onSearch: function () {
    const keyword = this.data.searchKeyword.trim();
    if (!keyword) {
      this.loadFabrics();
      return;
    }

    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .where({
        $or: [
          { code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { new_code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { type: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) }
        ]
      })
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('搜索失败', err);
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onImportExcel: function () {
    wx.chooseMessageFile({
      count: 1,
      type: 'file',
      extension: ['xlsx', 'xls'],
      success: res => {
        const tempFilePath = res.tempFiles[0].path;
        this.uploadAndImportExcel(tempFilePath);
      }
    });
  },

  uploadAndImportExcel: function (filePath) {
    wx.showLoading({ title: '导入中...' });
    
    wx.cloud.uploadFile({
      cloudPath: 'excel-import/' + Date.now() + '.xlsx',
      filePath: filePath,
      success: uploadRes => {
        wx.cloud.callFunction({
          name: 'importExcel',
          data: { fileID: uploadRes.fileID },
          success: importRes => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            if (importRes.result.success) {
              wx.showToast({
                title: `成功导入${importRes.result.count}条数据`,
                icon: 'success'
              });
              this.loadFabrics();
            } else {
              wx.showToast({
                title: importRes.result.message || '导入失败',
                icon: 'none'
              });
            }
          },
          fail: err => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            console.error('导入失败', err);
            wx.showToast({
              title: '导入失败',
              icon: 'none'
            });
          }
        });
      },
      fail: err => {
        wx.hideLoading();
        console.error('上传失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '上传失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
      }
    });
  },

  onAddFabric: function () {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: '/pages/fabric-edit/fabric-edit'
    });
  },

  goToDetail: function (e) {
    const id = e.currentTarget.dataset.id;
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/fabric-detail/fabric-detail?id=${id}`
    });
  }
});
```

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 创建index.js - 页面逻辑**

```javascript
const util = require('../../utils/util.js');
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabrics: [],
    searchKeyword: '',
    loading: false
  },

  onLoad: function () {
    this.loadFabrics();
  },

  onPullDownRefresh: function () {
    this.loadFabrics().then(() => {
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh();
    });
  },

  loadFabrics: function () {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    return db.collection('fabrics')
      .orderBy('create_time', 'desc')
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载面料失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onSearchInput: function (e) {
    this.setData({ searchKeyword: e.detail.value });
  },

  onSearch: function () {
    const keyword = this.data.searchKeyword.trim();
    if (!keyword) {
      this.loadFabrics();
      return;
    }

    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .where({
        $or: [
          { code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { new_code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { type: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) }
        ]
      })
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('搜索失败', err);
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onImportExcel: function () {
    wx.chooseMessageFile({
      count: 1,
      type: 'file',
      extension: ['xlsx', 'xls'],
      success: res => {
        const tempFilePath = res.tempFiles[0].path;
        this.uploadAndImportExcel(tempFilePath);
      }
    });
  },

  uploadAndImportExcel: function (filePath) {
    wx.showLoading({ title: '导入中...' });
    
    wx.cloud.uploadFile({
      cloudPath: 'excel-import/' + Date.now() + '.xlsx',
      filePath: filePath,
      success: uploadRes => {
        wx.cloud.callFunction({
          name: 'importExcel',
          data: { fileID: uploadRes.fileID },
          success: importRes => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            if (importRes.result.success) {
              wx.showToast({
                title: `成功导入${importRes.result.count}条数据`,
                icon: 'success'
              });
              this.loadFabrics();
            } else {
              wx.showToast({
                title: importRes.result.message || '导入失败',
                icon: 'none'
              });
            }
          },
          fail: err => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            console.error('导入失败', err);
            wx.showToast({
              title: '导入失败',
              icon: 'none'
            });
          }
        });
      },
      fail: err => {
        wx.hideLoading();
        console.error('上传失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '上传失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
      }
    });
  },

  onAddFabric: function () {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: '/pages/fabric-edit/fabric-edit'
    });
  },

  goToDetail: function (e) {
    const id = e.currentTarget.dataset.id;
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/fabric-detail/fabric-detail?id=${id}`
    });
  }
});
```

  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 创建index.js - 页面逻辑**

```javascript
const util = require('../../utils/util.js');
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabrics: [],
    searchKeyword: '',
    loading: false
  },

  onLoad: function () {
    this.loadFabrics();
  },

  onPullDownRefresh: function () {
    this.loadFabrics().then(() => {
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh();
    });
  },

  loadFabrics: function () {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    return db.collection('fabrics')
      .orderBy('create_time', 'desc')
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载面料失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onSearchInput: function (e) {
    this.setData({ searchKeyword: e.detail.value });
  },

  onSearch: function () {
    const keyword = this.data.searchKeyword.trim();
    if (!keyword) {
      this.loadFabrics();
      return;
    }

    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .where({
        $or: [
          { code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { new_code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { type: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) }
        ]
      })
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('搜索失败', err);
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onImportExcel: function () {
    wx.chooseMessageFile({
      count: 1,
      type: 'file',
      extension: ['xlsx', 'xls'],
      success: res => {
        const tempFilePath = res.tempFiles[0].path;
        this.uploadAndImportExcel(tempFilePath);
      }
    });
  },

  uploadAndImportExcel: function (filePath) {
    wx.showLoading({ title: '导入中...' });
    
    wx.cloud.uploadFile({
      cloudPath: 'excel-import/' + Date.now() + '.xlsx',
      filePath: filePath,
      success: uploadRes => {
        wx.cloud.callFunction({
          name: 'importExcel',
          data: { fileID: uploadRes.fileID },
          success: importRes => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            if (importRes.result.success) {
              wx.showToast({
                title: `成功导入${importRes.result.count}条数据`,
                icon: 'success'
              });
              this.loadFabrics();
            } else {
              wx.showToast({
                title: importRes.result.message || '导入失败',
                icon: 'none'
              });
            }
          },
          fail: err => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            console.error('导入失败', err);
            wx.showToast({
              title: '导入失败',
              icon: 'none'
            });
          }
        });
      },
      fail: err => {
        wx.hideLoading();
        console.error('上传失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '上传失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
      }
    });
  },

  onAddFabric: function () {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: '/pages/fabric-edit/fabric-edit'
    });
  },

  goToDetail: function (e) {
    const id = e.currentTarget.dataset.id;
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/fabric-detail/fabric-detail?id=${id}`
    });
  }
});
```

```javascript
const util = require('../../utils/util.js');
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabrics: [],
    searchKeyword: '',
    loading: false
  },

  onLoad: function () {
    this.loadFabrics();
  },

  onPullDownRefresh: function () {
    this.loadFabrics().then(() => {
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh();
    });
  },

  loadFabrics: function () {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    return db.collection('fabrics')
      .orderBy('create_time', 'desc')
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载面料失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onSearchInput: function (e) {
    this.setData({ searchKeyword: e.detail.value });
  },

  onSearch: function () {
    const keyword = this.data.searchKeyword.trim();
    if (!keyword) {
      this.loadFabrics();
      return;
    }

    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .where({
        $or: [
          { code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { new_code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { type: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) }
        ]
      })
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('搜索失败', err);
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onImportExcel: function () {
    wx.chooseMessageFile({
      count: 1,
      type: 'file',
      extension: ['xlsx', 'xls'],
      success: res => {
        const tempFilePath = res.tempFiles[0].path;
        this.uploadAndImportExcel(tempFilePath);
      }
    });
  },

  uploadAndImportExcel: function (filePath) {
    wx.showLoading({ title: '导入中...' });
    
    wx.cloud.uploadFile({
      cloudPath: 'excel-import/' + Date.now() + '.xlsx',
      filePath: filePath,
      success: uploadRes => {
        wx.cloud.callFunction({
          name: 'importExcel',
          data: { fileID: uploadRes.fileID },
          success: importRes => {
            wx.hideLoading();

              wx.showToast({
                title: `成功导入${importRes.result.count}条数据`,

              this.loadFabrics();

**Goal:** 构建一个极简的面料报价微信小程序，使用微信云开发，支持面料管理、报价生成和历史记录功能

**Architecture:** 采用微信云开发架构，前端使用微信小程序原生框架，后端使用微信云数据库和云函数

**Tech Stack:**
- 前端：微信小程序原生框架 (WXML + WXSS + JavaScript)
- 后端：微信云开发 (云数据库、云存储、云函数)
- 数据处理：xlsx库 (Excel解析)

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 创建index.js - 页面逻辑**

```javascript
const util = require('../../utils/util.js');
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabrics: [],
    searchKeyword: '',
    loading: false
  },

  onLoad: function () {
    this.loadFabrics();
  },

  onPullDownRefresh: function () {
    this.loadFabrics().then(() => {
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh();
    });
  },

  loadFabrics: function () {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    return db.collection('fabrics')
      .orderBy('create_time', 'desc')
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载面料失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onSearchInput: function (e) {
    this.setData({ searchKeyword: e.detail.value });
  },

  onSearch: function () {
    const keyword = this.data.searchKeyword.trim();
    if (!keyword) {
      this.loadFabrics();
      return;
    }

    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .where({
        $or: [
          { code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { new_code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { type: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) }
        ]
      })
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('搜索失败', err);
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onImportExcel: function () {
    wx.chooseMessageFile({
      count: 1,
      type: 'file',
      extension: ['xlsx', 'xls'],
      success: res => {
        const tempFilePath = res.tempFiles[0].path;
        this.uploadAndImportExcel(tempFilePath);
      }
    });
  },

  uploadAndImportExcel: function (filePath) {
    wx.showLoading({ title: '导入中...' });
    
    wx.cloud.uploadFile({
      cloudPath: 'excel-import/' + Date.now() + '.xlsx',
      filePath: filePath,
      success: uploadRes => {
        wx.cloud.callFunction({
          name: 'importExcel',
          data: { fileID: uploadRes.fileID },
          success: importRes => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            if (importRes.result.success) {
              wx.showToast({
                title: `成功导入${importRes.result.count}条数据`,
                icon: 'success'
              });
              this.loadFabrics();
            } else {
              wx.showToast({
                title: importRes.result.message || '导入失败',
                icon: 'none'
              });
            }
          },
          fail: err => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            console.error('导入失败', err);
            wx.showToast({
              title: '导入失败',
              icon: 'none'
            });
          }
        });
      },
      fail: err => {
        wx.hideLoading();
        console.error('上传失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '上传失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
      }
    });
  },

  onAddFabric: function () {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: '/pages/fabric-edit/fabric-edit'
    });
  },

  goToDetail: function (e) {
    const id = e.currentTarget.dataset.id;
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/fabric-detail/fabric-detail?id=${id}`
    });
  }
});
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 创建index.js - 页面逻辑**

```javascript
const util = require('../../utils/util.js');
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabrics: [],
    searchKeyword: '',
    loading: false
  },

  onLoad: function () {
    this.loadFabrics();
  },

  onPullDownRefresh: function () {
    this.loadFabrics().then(() => {
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh();
    });
  },

  loadFabrics: function () {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    return db.collection('fabrics')
      .orderBy('create_time', 'desc')
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载面料失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onSearchInput: function (e) {
    this.setData({ searchKeyword: e.detail.value });
  },

  onSearch: function () {
    const keyword = this.data.searchKeyword.trim();
    if (!keyword) {
      this.loadFabrics();
      return;
    }

    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .where({
        $or: [
          { code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { new_code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { type: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) }
        ]
      })
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('搜索失败', err);
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onImportExcel: function () {
    wx.chooseMessageFile({
      count: 1,
      type: 'file',
      extension: ['xlsx', 'xls'],
      success: res => {
        const tempFilePath = res.tempFiles[0].path;
        this.uploadAndImportExcel(tempFilePath);
      }
    });
  },

  uploadAndImportExcel: function (filePath) {
    wx.showLoading({ title: '导入中...' });
    
    wx.cloud.uploadFile({
      cloudPath: 'excel-import/' + Date.now() + '.xlsx',
      filePath: filePath,
      success: uploadRes => {
        wx.cloud.callFunction({
          name: 'importExcel',
          data: { fileID: uploadRes.fileID },
          success: importRes => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            if (importRes.result.success) {
              wx.showToast({
                title: `成功导入${importRes.result.count}条数据`,
                icon: 'success'
              });
              this.loadFabrics();
            } else {
              wx.showToast({
                title: importRes.result.message || '导入失败',
                icon: 'none'
              });
            }
          },
          fail: err => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            console.error('导入失败', err);
            wx.showToast({
              title: '导入失败',
              icon: 'none'
            });
          }
        });
      },
      fail: err => {
        wx.hideLoading();
        console.error('上传失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '上传失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
      }
    });
  },

  onAddFabric: function () {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: '/pages/fabric-edit/fabric-edit'
    });
  },

  goToDetail: function (e) {
    const id = e.currentTarget.dataset.id;
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/fabric-detail/fabric-detail?id=${id}`
    });
  }
});
```

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 创建index.js - 页面逻辑**

```javascript
const util = require('../../utils/util.js');
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabrics: [],
    searchKeyword: '',
    loading: false
  },

  onLoad: function () {
    this.loadFabrics();
  },

  onPullDownRefresh: function () {
    this.loadFabrics().then(() => {
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh();
    });
  },

  loadFabrics: function () {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    return db.collection('fabrics')
      .orderBy('create_time', 'desc')
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载面料失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onSearchInput: function (e) {
    this.setData({ searchKeyword: e.detail.value });
  },

  onSearch: function () {
    const keyword = this.data.searchKeyword.trim();
    if (!keyword) {
      this.loadFabrics();
      return;
    }

    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .where({
        $or: [
          { code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { new_code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { type: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) }
        ]
      })
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('搜索失败', err);
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onImportExcel: function () {
    wx.chooseMessageFile({
      count: 1,
      type: 'file',
      extension: ['xlsx', 'xls'],
      success: res => {
        const tempFilePath = res.tempFiles[0].path;
        this.uploadAndImportExcel(tempFilePath);
      }
    });
  },

  uploadAndImportExcel: function (filePath) {
    wx.showLoading({ title: '导入中...' });
    
    wx.cloud.uploadFile({
      cloudPath: 'excel-import/' + Date.now() + '.xlsx',
      filePath: filePath,
      success: uploadRes => {
        wx.cloud.callFunction({
          name: 'importExcel',
          data: { fileID: uploadRes.fileID },
          success: importRes => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            if (importRes.result.success) {
              wx.showToast({
                title: `成功导入${importRes.result.count}条数据`,
                icon: 'success'
              });
              this.loadFabrics();
            } else {
              wx.showToast({
                title: importRes.result.message || '导入失败',
                icon: 'none'
              });
            }
          },
          fail: err => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            console.error('导入失败', err);
            wx.showToast({
              title: '导入失败',
              icon: 'none'
            });
          }
        });
      },
      fail: err => {
        wx.hideLoading();
        console.error('上传失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '上传失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
      }
    });
  },

  onAddFabric: function () {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: '/pages/fabric-edit/fabric-edit'
    });
  },

  goToDetail: function (e) {
    const id = e.currentTarget.dataset.id;
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/fabric-detail/fabric-detail?id=${id}`
    });
  }
});
```

    <view class="detail-section">

      <view class="detail-row">
# 面料报价微信小程序 - 轻量化实施计划

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** 构建一个极简的面料报价微信小程序，使用微信云开发，支持面料管理、报价生成和历史记录功能

**Architecture:** 采用微信云开发架构，前端使用微信小程序原生框架，后端使用微信云数据库和云函数

**Tech Stack:**
- 前端：微信小程序原生框架 (WXML + WXSS + JavaScript)
- 后端：微信云开发 (云数据库、云存储、云函数)
- 数据处理：xlsx库 (Excel解析)

const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();

  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};

- [ ] **Step 4: 创建index.js - 页面逻辑**

```javascript
const util = require('../../utils/util.js');
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabrics: [],
    searchKeyword: '',
    loading: false
  },

  onLoad: function () {
    this.loadFabrics();
  },

  onPullDownRefresh: function () {
    this.loadFabrics().then(() => {
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh();
    });
  },

  loadFabrics: function () {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    return db.collection('fabrics')
      .orderBy('create_time', 'desc')
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载面料失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onSearchInput: function (e) {
    this.setData({ searchKeyword: e.detail.value });
  },

  onSearch: function () {
    const keyword = this.data.searchKeyword.trim();
    if (!keyword) {
      this.loadFabrics();
      return;
    }

    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .where({
        $or: [
          { code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { new_code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { type: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) }
        ]
      })
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('搜索失败', err);
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onImportExcel: function () {
    wx.chooseMessageFile({
      count: 1,
      type: 'file',
      extension: ['xlsx', 'xls'],
      success: res => {
        const tempFilePath = res.tempFiles[0].path;
        this.uploadAndImportExcel(tempFilePath);
      }
    });
  },

  uploadAndImportExcel: function (filePath) {
    wx.showLoading({ title: '导入中...' });
    
    wx.cloud.uploadFile({
      cloudPath: 'excel-import/' + Date.now() + '.xlsx',
      filePath: filePath,
      success: uploadRes => {
        wx.cloud.callFunction({
          name: 'importExcel',
          data: { fileID: uploadRes.fileID },
          success: importRes => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            if (importRes.result.success) {
              wx.showToast({
                title: `成功导入${importRes.result.count}条数据`,
                icon: 'success'
              });
              this.loadFabrics();
            } else {
              wx.showToast({
                title: importRes.result.message || '导入失败',
                icon: 'none'
              });
            }
          },
          fail: err => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            console.error('导入失败', err);
            wx.showToast({
              title: '导入失败',
              icon: 'none'
            });
          }
        });
      },
      fail: err => {
        wx.hideLoading();
        console.error('上传失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '上传失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
      }
    });
  },

  onAddFabric: function () {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: '/pages/fabric-edit/fabric-edit'
    });
  },

  goToDetail: function (e) {
    const id = e.currentTarget.dataset.id;
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/fabric-detail/fabric-detail?id=${id}`
    });
  }
});
```

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```
