  data: {
    fabric: null,
    loading: true
  },

  onLoad: function (options) {
    if (options.id) {
      this.loadFabricDetail(options.id);
    }
  },

  loadFabricDetail: function (id) {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .doc(id)
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabric: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载详情失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onEdit: function () {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/fabric-edit/fabric-edit?id=${this.data.fabric._id}`
    });
  },

  addToQuotation: function () {
    const fabric = this.data.fabric;
    const pages = getCurrentPages();
    const prevPage = pages[pages.length - 2];
    
    if (prevPage && prevPage.route === 'pages/quotation/quotation') {
      if (prevPage.data.selectedFabrics) {
        const selectedFabrics = [...prevPage.data.selectedFabrics, {
          ...fabric,
          quantity: 1,
          unit: '米',
          unitPrice: fabric.sample_price_meter || 0,
          remark: ''
        }];
        prevPage.setData({ selectedFabrics });
      }
      wx.navigateBack();
    } else {
      wx.switchTab({
        url: '/pages/quotation/quotation'
      });
    }
  }
});
```

# 面料报价微信小程序 - 轻量化实施计划

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** 构建一个极简的面料报价微信小程序，使用微信云开发，支持面料管理、报价生成和历史记录功能

**Architecture:** 采用微信云开发架构，前端使用微信小程序原生框架，后端使用微信云数据库和云函数

**Tech Stack:**
- 前端：微信小程序原生框架 (WXML + WXSS + JavaScript)
- 后端：微信云开发 (云数据库、云存储、云函数)
- 数据处理：xlsx库 (Excel解析)

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 创建index.js - 页面逻辑**

```javascript
const util = require('../../utils/util.js');
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabrics: [],
    searchKeyword: '',
    loading: false
  },

  onLoad: function () {
    this.loadFabrics();
  },

  onPullDownRefresh: function () {
    this.loadFabrics().then(() => {
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh();
    });
  },

  loadFabrics: function () {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    return db.collection('fabrics')
      .orderBy('create_time', 'desc')
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载面料失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onSearchInput: function (e) {
    this.setData({ searchKeyword: e.detail.value });
  },

  onSearch: function () {
    const keyword = this.data.searchKeyword.trim();
    if (!keyword) {
      this.loadFabrics();
      return;
    }

    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .where({
        $or: [
          { code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { new_code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { type: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) }
        ]
      })
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('搜索失败', err);
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onImportExcel: function () {
    wx.chooseMessageFile({
      count: 1,
      type: 'file',
      extension: ['xlsx', 'xls'],
      success: res => {
        const tempFilePath = res.tempFiles[0].path;
        this.uploadAndImportExcel(tempFilePath);
      }
    });
  },

  uploadAndImportExcel: function (filePath) {
    wx.showLoading({ title: '导入中...' });
    
    wx.cloud.uploadFile({
      cloudPath: 'excel-import/' + Date.now() + '.xlsx',
      filePath: filePath,
      success: uploadRes => {
        wx.cloud.callFunction({
          name: 'importExcel',
          data: { fileID: uploadRes.fileID },
          success: importRes => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            if (importRes.result.success) {
              wx.showToast({
                title: `成功导入${importRes.result.count}条数据`,
                icon: 'success'
              });
              this.loadFabrics();
            } else {
              wx.showToast({
                title: importRes.result.message || '导入失败',
                icon: 'none'
              });
            }
          },
          fail: err => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            console.error('导入失败', err);
            wx.showToast({
              title: '导入失败',
              icon: 'none'
            });
          }
        });
      },
      fail: err => {
        wx.hideLoading();
        console.error('上传失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '上传失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
      }
    });
  },

  onAddFabric: function () {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: '/pages/fabric-edit/fabric-edit'
    });
  },

  goToDetail: function (e) {
    const id = e.currentTarget.dataset.id;
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/fabric-detail/fabric-detail?id=${id}`
    });
  }
});
```

```javascript
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabric: null,
    loading: true
  },

  onLoad: function (options) {
    if (options.id) {
      this.loadFabricDetail(options.id);
    }
  },

  loadFabricDetail: function (id) {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .doc(id)
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabric: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载详情失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onEdit: function () {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/fabric-edit/fabric-edit?id=${this.data.fabric._id}`
    });
  },

  addToQuotation: function () {
    const fabric = this.data.fabric;
    const pages = getCurrentPages();
    const prevPage = pages[pages.length - 2];
    
    if (prevPage && prevPage.route === 'pages/quotation/quotation') {
      if (prevPage.data.selectedFabrics) {
        const selectedFabrics = [...prevPage.data.selectedFabrics, {
          ...fabric,
          quantity: 1,
          unit: '米',
          unitPrice: fabric.sample_price_meter || 0,
          remark: ''
        }];
        prevPage.setData({ selectedFabrics });
      }
      wx.navigateBack();
    } else {
      wx.switchTab({
        url: '/pages/quotation/quotation'
      });
    }
  }
});
```

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 创建index.js - 页面逻辑**

```javascript
const util = require('../../utils/util.js');
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabrics: [],
    searchKeyword: '',
    loading: false
  },

  onLoad: function () {
    this.loadFabrics();
  },

  onPullDownRefresh: function () {
    this.loadFabrics().then(() => {
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh();
    });
  },

  loadFabrics: function () {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    return db.collection('fabrics')
      .orderBy('create_time', 'desc')
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载面料失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onSearchInput: function (e) {
    this.setData({ searchKeyword: e.detail.value });
  },

  onSearch: function () {
    const keyword = this.data.searchKeyword.trim();
    if (!keyword) {
      this.loadFabrics();
      return;
    }

    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .where({
        $or: [
          { code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { new_code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { type: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) }
        ]
      })
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('搜索失败', err);
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onImportExcel: function () {
    wx.chooseMessageFile({
      count: 1,
      type: 'file',
      extension: ['xlsx', 'xls'],
      success: res => {
        const tempFilePath = res.tempFiles[0].path;
        this.uploadAndImportExcel(tempFilePath);
      }
    });
  },

  uploadAndImportExcel: function (filePath) {
    wx.showLoading({ title: '导入中...' });
    
    wx.cloud.uploadFile({
      cloudPath: 'excel-import/' + Date.now() + '.xlsx',
      filePath: filePath,
      success: uploadRes => {
        wx.cloud.callFunction({
          name: 'importExcel',
          data: { fileID: uploadRes.fileID },
          success: importRes => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            if (importRes.result.success) {
              wx.showToast({
                title: `成功导入${importRes.result.count}条数据`,
                icon: 'success'
              });
              this.loadFabrics();
            } else {
              wx.showToast({
                title: importRes.result.message || '导入失败',
                icon: 'none'
              });
            }
          },
          fail: err => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            console.error('导入失败', err);
            wx.showToast({
              title: '导入失败',
              icon: 'none'
            });
          }
        });
      },
      fail: err => {
        wx.hideLoading();
        console.error('上传失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '上传失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
      }
    });
  },

  onAddFabric: function () {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: '/pages/fabric-edit/fabric-edit'
    });
  },

  goToDetail: function (e) {
    const id = e.currentTarget.dataset.id;
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/fabric-detail/fabric-detail?id=${id}`
    });
  }
});
```

```javascript
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabric: null,
    loading: true
  },

  onLoad: function (options) {
    if (options.id) {
      this.loadFabricDetail(options.id);
    }
  },

  loadFabricDetail: function (id) {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .doc(id)
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabric: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载详情失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onEdit: function () {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/fabric-edit/fabric-edit?id=${this.data.fabric._id}`
    });
  },

  addToQuotation: function () {
    const fabric = this.data.fabric;
    const pages = getCurrentPages();
    const prevPage = pages[pages.length - 2];
    
    if (prevPage && prevPage.route === 'pages/quotation/quotation') {
      if (prevPage.data.selectedFabrics) {
        const selectedFabrics = [...prevPage.data.selectedFabrics, {
          ...fabric,
          quantity: 1,
          unit: '米',
          unitPrice: fabric.sample_price_meter || 0,
          remark: ''
        }];
        prevPage.setData({ selectedFabrics });
      }
      wx.navigateBack();
    } else {
      wx.switchTab({
        url: '/pages/quotation/quotation'
      });
    }
  }
});
```

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 创建index.js - 页面逻辑**

```javascript
const util = require('../../utils/util.js');
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabrics: [],
    searchKeyword: '',
    loading: false
  },

  onLoad: function () {
    this.loadFabrics();
  },

  onPullDownRefresh: function () {
    this.loadFabrics().then(() => {
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh();
    });
  },

  loadFabrics: function () {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    return db.collection('fabrics')
      .orderBy('create_time', 'desc')
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载面料失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onSearchInput: function (e) {
    this.setData({ searchKeyword: e.detail.value });
  },

  onSearch: function () {
    const keyword = this.data.searchKeyword.trim();
    if (!keyword) {
      this.loadFabrics();
      return;
    }

    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .where({
        $or: [
          { code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { new_code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { type: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) }
        ]
      })
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('搜索失败', err);
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onImportExcel: function () {
    wx.chooseMessageFile({
      count: 1,
      type: 'file',
      extension: ['xlsx', 'xls'],
      success: res => {
        const tempFilePath = res.tempFiles[0].path;
        this.uploadAndImportExcel(tempFilePath);
      }
    });
  },

  uploadAndImportExcel: function (filePath) {
    wx.showLoading({ title: '导入中...' });
    
    wx.cloud.uploadFile({
      cloudPath: 'excel-import/' + Date.now() + '.xlsx',
      filePath: filePath,
      success: uploadRes => {
        wx.cloud.callFunction({
          name: 'importExcel',
          data: { fileID: uploadRes.fileID },
          success: importRes => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            if (importRes.result.success) {
              wx.showToast({
                title: `成功导入${importRes.result.count}条数据`,
                icon: 'success'
              });
              this.loadFabrics();
            } else {
              wx.showToast({
                title: importRes.result.message || '导入失败',
                icon: 'none'
              });
            }
          },
          fail: err => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            console.error('导入失败', err);
            wx.showToast({
              title: '导入失败',
              icon: 'none'
            });
          }
        });
      },
      fail: err => {
        wx.hideLoading();
        console.error('上传失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '上传失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
      }
    });
  },

  onAddFabric: function () {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: '/pages/fabric-edit/fabric-edit'
    });
  },

  goToDetail: function (e) {
    const id = e.currentTarget.dataset.id;
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/fabric-detail/fabric-detail?id=${id}`
    });
  }
});
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 创建fabric-detail.js - 页面逻辑**

```javascript
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabric: null,
    loading: true
  },

  onLoad: function (options) {
    if (options.id) {
      this.loadFabricDetail(options.id);
    }
  },

  loadFabricDetail: function (id) {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .doc(id)
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabric: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载详情失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onEdit: function () {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/fabric-edit/fabric-edit?id=${this.data.fabric._id}`
    });
  },

  addToQuotation: function () {
    const fabric = this.data.fabric;
    const pages = getCurrentPages();
    const prevPage = pages[pages.length - 2];
    
    if (prevPage && prevPage.route === 'pages/quotation/quotation') {
      if (prevPage.data.selectedFabrics) {
        const selectedFabrics = [...prevPage.data.selectedFabrics, {
          ...fabric,
          quantity: 1,
          unit: '米',
          unitPrice: fabric.sample_price_meter || 0,
          remark: ''
        }];
        prevPage.setData({ selectedFabrics });
      }
      wx.navigateBack();
    } else {
      wx.switchTab({
        url: '/pages/quotation/quotation'
      });
    }
  }
});
```

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** 构建一个极简的面料报价微信小程序，使用微信云开发，支持面料管理、报价生成和历史记录功能

**Architecture:** 采用微信云开发架构，前端使用微信小程序原生框架，后端使用微信云数据库和云函数

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 创建index.js - 页面逻辑**

```javascript
const util = require('../../utils/util.js');
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabrics: [],
    searchKeyword: '',
    loading: false
  },

  onLoad: function () {
    this.loadFabrics();
  },

  onPullDownRefresh: function () {
    this.loadFabrics().then(() => {
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh();
    });
  },

  loadFabrics: function () {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    return db.collection('fabrics')
      .orderBy('create_time', 'desc')
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载面料失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onSearchInput: function (e) {
    this.setData({ searchKeyword: e.detail.value });
  },

  onSearch: function () {
    const keyword = this.data.searchKeyword.trim();
    if (!keyword) {
      this.loadFabrics();
      return;
    }

    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .where({
        $or: [
          { code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { new_code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { type: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) }
        ]
      })
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('搜索失败', err);
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onImportExcel: function () {
    wx.chooseMessageFile({
      count: 1,
      type: 'file',
      extension: ['xlsx', 'xls'],
      success: res => {
        const tempFilePath = res.tempFiles[0].path;
        this.uploadAndImportExcel(tempFilePath);
      }
    });
  },

  uploadAndImportExcel: function (filePath) {
    wx.showLoading({ title: '导入中...' });
    
    wx.cloud.uploadFile({
      cloudPath: 'excel-import/' + Date.now() + '.xlsx',
      filePath: filePath,
      success: uploadRes => {
        wx.cloud.callFunction({
          name: 'importExcel',
          data: { fileID: uploadRes.fileID },
          success: importRes => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            if (importRes.result.success) {
              wx.showToast({
                title: `成功导入${importRes.result.count}条数据`,
                icon: 'success'
              });
              this.loadFabrics();
            } else {
              wx.showToast({
                title: importRes.result.message || '导入失败',
                icon: 'none'
              });
            }
          },
          fail: err => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            console.error('导入失败', err);
            wx.showToast({
              title: '导入失败',
              icon: 'none'
            });
          }
        });
      },
      fail: err => {
        wx.hideLoading();
        console.error('上传失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '上传失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
      }
    });
  },

  onAddFabric: function () {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: '/pages/fabric-edit/fabric-edit'
    });
  },

  goToDetail: function (e) {
    const id = e.currentTarget.dataset.id;
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/fabric-detail/fabric-detail?id=${id}`
    });
  }
});
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 创建fabric-detail.js - 页面逻辑**

```javascript
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabric: null,
    loading: true
  },

  onLoad: function (options) {
    if (options.id) {
      this.loadFabricDetail(options.id);
    }
  },

  loadFabricDetail: function (id) {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .doc(id)
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabric: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载详情失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onEdit: function () {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/fabric-edit/fabric-edit?id=${this.data.fabric._id}`
    });
  },

  addToQuotation: function () {
    const fabric = this.data.fabric;
    const pages = getCurrentPages();
    const prevPage = pages[pages.length - 2];
    
    if (prevPage && prevPage.route === 'pages/quotation/quotation') {
      if (prevPage.data.selectedFabrics) {
        const selectedFabrics = [...prevPage.data.selectedFabrics, {
          ...fabric,
          quantity: 1,
          unit: '米',
          unitPrice: fabric.sample_price_meter || 0,
          remark: ''
        }];
        prevPage.setData({ selectedFabrics });
      }
      wx.navigateBack();
    } else {
      wx.switchTab({
        url: '/pages/quotation/quotation'
      });
    }
  }
});
```

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** 构建一个极简的面料报价微信小程序，使用微信云开发，支持面料管理、报价生成和历史记录功能

**Architecture:** 采用微信云开发架构，前端使用微信小程序原生框架，后端使用微信云数据库和云函数

**Tech Stack:**
- 前端：微信小程序原生框架 (WXML + WXSS + JavaScript)
- 后端：微信云开发 (云数据库、云存储、云函数)
- 数据处理：xlsx库 (Excel解析)

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 创建index.js - 页面逻辑**

```javascript
const util = require('../../utils/util.js');
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabrics: [],
    searchKeyword: '',
    loading: false
  },

  onLoad: function () {
    this.loadFabrics();
  },

  onPullDownRefresh: function () {
    this.loadFabrics().then(() => {
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh();
    });
  },

  loadFabrics: function () {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    return db.collection('fabrics')
      .orderBy('create_time', 'desc')
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载面料失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onSearchInput: function (e) {
    this.setData({ searchKeyword: e.detail.value });
  },

  onSearch: function () {
    const keyword = this.data.searchKeyword.trim();
    if (!keyword) {
      this.loadFabrics();
      return;
    }

    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .where({
        $or: [
          { code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { new_code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { type: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) }
        ]
      })
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('搜索失败', err);
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onImportExcel: function () {
    wx.chooseMessageFile({
      count: 1,
      type: 'file',
      extension: ['xlsx', 'xls'],
      success: res => {
        const tempFilePath = res.tempFiles[0].path;
        this.uploadAndImportExcel(tempFilePath);
      }
    });
  },

  uploadAndImportExcel: function (filePath) {
    wx.showLoading({ title: '导入中...' });
    
    wx.cloud.uploadFile({
      cloudPath: 'excel-import/' + Date.now() + '.xlsx',
      filePath: filePath,
      success: uploadRes => {
        wx.cloud.callFunction({
          name: 'importExcel',
          data: { fileID: uploadRes.fileID },
          success: importRes => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            if (importRes.result.success) {
              wx.showToast({
                title: `成功导入${importRes.result.count}条数据`,
                icon: 'success'
              });
              this.loadFabrics();
            } else {
              wx.showToast({
                title: importRes.result.message || '导入失败',
                icon: 'none'
              });
            }
          },
          fail: err => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            console.error('导入失败', err);
            wx.showToast({
              title: '导入失败',
              icon: 'none'
            });
          }
        });
      },
      fail: err => {
        wx.hideLoading();
        console.error('上传失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '上传失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
      }
    });
  },

  onAddFabric: function () {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: '/pages/fabric-edit/fabric-edit'
    });
  },

  goToDetail: function (e) {
    const id = e.currentTarget.dataset.id;
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/fabric-detail/fabric-detail?id=${id}`
    });
  }
});
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 创建fabric-detail.js - 页面逻辑**

```javascript
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabric: null,
    loading: true
  },

  onLoad: function (options) {
    if (options.id) {
      this.loadFabricDetail(options.id);
    }
  },

  loadFabricDetail: function (id) {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .doc(id)
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabric: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载详情失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onEdit: function () {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/fabric-edit/fabric-edit?id=${this.data.fabric._id}`
    });
  },

  addToQuotation: function () {
    const fabric = this.data.fabric;
    const pages = getCurrentPages();
    const prevPage = pages[pages.length - 2];
    
    if (prevPage && prevPage.route === 'pages/quotation/quotation') {
      if (prevPage.data.selectedFabrics) {
        const selectedFabrics = [...prevPage.data.selectedFabrics, {
          ...fabric,
          quantity: 1,
          unit: '米',
          unitPrice: fabric.sample_price_meter || 0,
          remark: ''
        }];
        prevPage.setData({ selectedFabrics });
      }
      wx.navigateBack();
    } else {
      wx.switchTab({
        url: '/pages/quotation/quotation'
      });
    }
  }
});
```

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** 构建一个极简的面料报价微信小程序，使用微信云开发，支持面料管理、报价生成和历史记录功能

**Architecture:** 采用微信云开发架构，前端使用微信小程序原生框架，后端使用微信云数据库和云函数

**Tech Stack:**
- 前端：微信小程序原生框架 (WXML + WXSS + JavaScript)
- 后端：微信云开发 (云数据库、云存储、云函数)
- 数据处理：xlsx库 (Excel解析)

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 创建index.js - 页面逻辑**

```javascript
const util = require('../../utils/util.js');
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabrics: [],
    searchKeyword: '',
    loading: false
  },

  onLoad: function () {
    this.loadFabrics();
  },

  onPullDownRefresh: function () {
    this.loadFabrics().then(() => {
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh();
    });
  },

  loadFabrics: function () {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    return db.collection('fabrics')
      .orderBy('create_time', 'desc')
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载面料失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onSearchInput: function (e) {
    this.setData({ searchKeyword: e.detail.value });
  },

  onSearch: function () {
    const keyword = this.data.searchKeyword.trim();
    if (!keyword) {
      this.loadFabrics();
      return;
    }

    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .where({
        $or: [
          { code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { new_code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { type: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) }
        ]
      })
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('搜索失败', err);
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onImportExcel: function () {
    wx.chooseMessageFile({
      count: 1,
      type: 'file',
      extension: ['xlsx', 'xls'],
      success: res => {
        const tempFilePath = res.tempFiles[0].path;
        this.uploadAndImportExcel(tempFilePath);
      }
    });
  },

  uploadAndImportExcel: function (filePath) {
    wx.showLoading({ title: '导入中...' });
    
    wx.cloud.uploadFile({
      cloudPath: 'excel-import/' + Date.now() + '.xlsx',
      filePath: filePath,
      success: uploadRes => {
        wx.cloud.callFunction({
          name: 'importExcel',
          data: { fileID: uploadRes.fileID },
          success: importRes => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            if (importRes.result.success) {
              wx.showToast({
                title: `成功导入${importRes.result.count}条数据`,
                icon: 'success'
              });
              this.loadFabrics();
            } else {
              wx.showToast({
                title: importRes.result.message || '导入失败',
                icon: 'none'
              });
            }
          },
          fail: err => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            console.error('导入失败', err);
            wx.showToast({
              title: '导入失败',
              icon: 'none'
            });
          }
        });
      },
      fail: err => {
        wx.hideLoading();
        console.error('上传失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '上传失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
      }
    });
  },

  onAddFabric: function () {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: '/pages/fabric-edit/fabric-edit'
    });
  },

  goToDetail: function (e) {
    const id = e.currentTarget.dataset.id;
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/fabric-detail/fabric-detail?id=${id}`
    });
  }
});
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 创建fabric-detail.js - 页面逻辑**

```javascript
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabric: null,
    loading: true
  },

  onLoad: function (options) {
    if (options.id) {
      this.loadFabricDetail(options.id);
    }
  },

  loadFabricDetail: function (id) {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .doc(id)
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabric: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载详情失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onEdit: function () {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/fabric-edit/fabric-edit?id=${this.data.fabric._id}`
    });
  },

  addToQuotation: function () {
    const fabric = this.data.fabric;
    const pages = getCurrentPages();
    const prevPage = pages[pages.length - 2];
    
    if (prevPage && prevPage.route === 'pages/quotation/quotation') {
      if (prevPage.data.selectedFabrics) {
        const selectedFabrics = [...prevPage.data.selectedFabrics, {
          ...fabric,
          quantity: 1,
          unit: '米',
          unitPrice: fabric.sample_price_meter || 0,
          remark: ''
        }];
        prevPage.setData({ selectedFabrics });
      }
      wx.navigateBack();
    } else {
      wx.switchTab({
        url: '/pages/quotation/quotation'
      });
    }
  }
});
```

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 创建index.js - 页面逻辑**

```javascript
const util = require('../../utils/util.js');
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabrics: [],
    searchKeyword: '',
    loading: false
  },

  onLoad: function () {
    this.loadFabrics();
  },

  onPullDownRefresh: function () {
    this.loadFabrics().then(() => {
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh();
    });
  },

  loadFabrics: function () {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    return db.collection('fabrics')
      .orderBy('create_time', 'desc')
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载面料失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onSearchInput: function (e) {
    this.setData({ searchKeyword: e.detail.value });
  },

  onSearch: function () {
    const keyword = this.data.searchKeyword.trim();
    if (!keyword) {
      this.loadFabrics();
      return;
    }

    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .where({
        $or: [
          { code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { new_code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { type: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) }
        ]
      })
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('搜索失败', err);
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onImportExcel: function () {
    wx.chooseMessageFile({
      count: 1,
      type: 'file',
      extension: ['xlsx', 'xls'],
      success: res => {
        const tempFilePath = res.tempFiles[0].path;
        this.uploadAndImportExcel(tempFilePath);
      }
    });
  },

  uploadAndImportExcel: function (filePath) {
    wx.showLoading({ title: '导入中...' });
    
    wx.cloud.uploadFile({
      cloudPath: 'excel-import/' + Date.now() + '.xlsx',
      filePath: filePath,
      success: uploadRes => {
        wx.cloud.callFunction({
          name: 'importExcel',
          data: { fileID: uploadRes.fileID },
          success: importRes => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            if (importRes.result.success) {
              wx.showToast({
                title: `成功导入${importRes.result.count}条数据`,
                icon: 'success'
              });
              this.loadFabrics();
            } else {
              wx.showToast({
                title: importRes.result.message || '导入失败',
                icon: 'none'
              });
            }
          },
          fail: err => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            console.error('导入失败', err);
            wx.showToast({
              title: '导入失败',
              icon: 'none'
            });
          }
        });
      },
      fail: err => {
        wx.hideLoading();
        console.error('上传失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '上传失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
      }
    });
  },

  onAddFabric: function () {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: '/pages/fabric-edit/fabric-edit'
    });
  },

  goToDetail: function (e) {

- [ ] **Step 4: 创建fabric-detail.js - 页面逻辑**

```javascript
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabric: null,
    loading: true
  },

  onLoad: function (options) {
    if (options.id) {
      this.loadFabricDetail(options.id);
    }
  },

  loadFabricDetail: function (id) {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .doc(id)
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabric: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载详情失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onEdit: function () {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/fabric-edit/fabric-edit?id=${this.data.fabric._id}`
    });
  },

  addToQuotation: function () {
    const fabric = this.data.fabric;
    const pages = getCurrentPages();
    const prevPage = pages[pages.length - 2];
    
    if (prevPage && prevPage.route === 'pages/quotation/quotation') {
      if (prevPage.data.selectedFabrics) {
        const selectedFabrics = [...prevPage.data.selectedFabrics, {
          ...fabric,
          quantity: 1,
          unit: '米',
          unitPrice: fabric.sample_price_meter || 0,
          remark: ''
        }];
        prevPage.setData({ selectedFabrics });
      }
      wx.navigateBack();
    } else {
      wx.switchTab({
        url: '/pages/quotation/quotation'
      });
    }
  }
});
```

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 创建index.js - 页面逻辑**

```javascript
const util = require('../../utils/util.js');
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabrics: [],
    searchKeyword: '',
    loading: false
  },

  onLoad: function () {
    this.loadFabrics();
  },

  onPullDownRefresh: function () {
    this.loadFabrics().then(() => {
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh();
    });
  },

  loadFabrics: function () {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    return db.collection('fabrics')
      .orderBy('create_time', 'desc')
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载面料失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onSearchInput: function (e) {
    this.setData({ searchKeyword: e.detail.value });
  },

  onSearch: function () {
    const keyword = this.data.searchKeyword.trim();
    if (!keyword) {
      this.loadFabrics();
      return;
    }

    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .where({
        $or: [
          { code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { new_code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { type: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) }
        ]
      })
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('搜索失败', err);
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onImportExcel: function () {
    wx.chooseMessageFile({
      count: 1,
      type: 'file',
      extension: ['xlsx', 'xls'],
      success: res => {
        const tempFilePath = res.tempFiles[0].path;
        this.uploadAndImportExcel(tempFilePath);
      }
    });
  },

  uploadAndImportExcel: function (filePath) {
    wx.showLoading({ title: '导入中...' });
    
    wx.cloud.uploadFile({
      cloudPath: 'excel-import/' + Date.now() + '.xlsx',
      filePath: filePath,
      success: uploadRes => {
        wx.cloud.callFunction({
          name: 'importExcel',
          data: { fileID: uploadRes.fileID },
          success: importRes => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            if (importRes.result.success) {
              wx.showToast({
                title: `成功导入${importRes.result.count}条数据`,
                icon: 'success'
              });
              this.loadFabrics();
            } else {
              wx.showToast({
                title: importRes.result.message || '导入失败',
                icon: 'none'
              });
            }
          },
          fail: err => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            console.error('导入失败', err);
            wx.showToast({
              title: '导入失败',
              icon: 'none'
            });
          }
        });
      },
      fail: err => {
        wx.hideLoading();
        console.error('上传失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '上传失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
      }
    });
  },

  onAddFabric: function () {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: '/pages/fabric-edit/fabric-edit'
    });
  },

  goToDetail: function (e) {
    const id = e.currentTarget.dataset.id;
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/fabric-detail/fabric-detail?id=${id}`
    });
  }
});
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 创建fabric-detail.js - 页面逻辑**

```javascript
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabric: null,
    loading: true
  },

  onLoad: function (options) {
    if (options.id) {
      this.loadFabricDetail(options.id);
    }
  },

  loadFabricDetail: function (id) {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .doc(id)
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabric: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载详情失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onEdit: function () {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/fabric-edit/fabric-edit?id=${this.data.fabric._id}`
    });
  },

  addToQuotation: function () {
    const fabric = this.data.fabric;
    const pages = getCurrentPages();
    const prevPage = pages[pages.length - 2];
    
    if (prevPage && prevPage.route === 'pages/quotation/quotation') {
      if (prevPage.data.selectedFabrics) {
        const selectedFabrics = [...prevPage.data.selectedFabrics, {
          ...fabric,
          quantity: 1,
          unit: '米',
          unitPrice: fabric.sample_price_meter || 0,
          remark: ''
        }];
        prevPage.setData({ selectedFabrics });
      }
      wx.navigateBack();
    } else {
      wx.switchTab({
        url: '/pages/quotation/quotation'
      });
    }
  }
});
```

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 创建index.js - 页面逻辑**

```javascript
const util = require('../../utils/util.js');
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabrics: [],
    searchKeyword: '',
    loading: false
  },

  onLoad: function () {
    this.loadFabrics();
  },

  onPullDownRefresh: function () {
    this.loadFabrics().then(() => {
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh();
    });
  },

  loadFabrics: function () {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    return db.collection('fabrics')
      .orderBy('create_time', 'desc')
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载面料失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onSearchInput: function (e) {
    this.setData({ searchKeyword: e.detail.value });
  },

  onSearch: function () {
    const keyword = this.data.searchKeyword.trim();
    if (!keyword) {
      this.loadFabrics();
      return;
    }

    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .where({
        $or: [
          { code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { new_code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { type: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) }
        ]
      })
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('搜索失败', err);
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onImportExcel: function () {
    wx.chooseMessageFile({
      count: 1,
      type: 'file',
      extension: ['xlsx', 'xls'],
      success: res => {
        const tempFilePath = res.tempFiles[0].path;
        this.uploadAndImportExcel(tempFilePath);
      }
    });
  },

  uploadAndImportExcel: function (filePath) {
    wx.showLoading({ title: '导入中...' });
    
    wx.cloud.uploadFile({
      cloudPath: 'excel-import/' + Date.now() + '.xlsx',
      filePath: filePath,
      success: uploadRes => {
        wx.cloud.callFunction({
          name: 'importExcel',
          data: { fileID: uploadRes.fileID },
          success: importRes => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            if (importRes.result.success) {
              wx.showToast({
                title: `成功导入${importRes.result.count}条数据`,
                icon: 'success'
              });
              this.loadFabrics();
            } else {
              wx.showToast({
                title: importRes.result.message || '导入失败',
                icon: 'none'
              });
            }
          },
          fail: err => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            console.error('导入失败', err);
            wx.showToast({
              title: '导入失败',
              icon: 'none'
            });
          }
        });
      },
      fail: err => {
        wx.hideLoading();
        console.error('上传失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '上传失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
      }
    });
  },

  onAddFabric: function () {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: '/pages/fabric-edit/fabric-edit'
    });
  },

  goToDetail: function (e) {
    const id = e.currentTarget.dataset.id;
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/fabric-detail/fabric-detail?id=${id}`
    });
  }
});
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 创建fabric-detail.js - 页面逻辑**

```javascript
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabric: null,
    loading: true
  },

  onLoad: function (options) {
    if (options.id) {
      this.loadFabricDetail(options.id);
    }
  },

  loadFabricDetail: function (id) {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .doc(id)
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabric: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载详情失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onEdit: function () {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/fabric-edit/fabric-edit?id=${this.data.fabric._id}`
    });
  },

  addToQuotation: function () {
    const fabric = this.data.fabric;
    const pages = getCurrentPages();
    const prevPage = pages[pages.length - 2];
    
    if (prevPage && prevPage.route === 'pages/quotation/quotation') {
      if (prevPage.data.selectedFabrics) {
        const selectedFabrics = [...prevPage.data.selectedFabrics, {
          ...fabric,
          quantity: 1,
          unit: '米',
          unitPrice: fabric.sample_price_meter || 0,
          remark: ''
        }];
        prevPage.setData({ selectedFabrics });
      }
      wx.navigateBack();
    } else {
      wx.switchTab({
        url: '/pages/quotation/quotation'
      });
    }
  }
});
```

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 创建index.js - 页面逻辑**

```javascript
const util = require('../../utils/util.js');
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabrics: [],
    searchKeyword: '',
    loading: false
  },

  onLoad: function () {
    this.loadFabrics();
  },

  onPullDownRefresh: function () {
    this.loadFabrics().then(() => {
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh();
    });
  },

  loadFabrics: function () {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    return db.collection('fabrics')
      .orderBy('create_time', 'desc')
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载面料失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onSearchInput: function (e) {
    this.setData({ searchKeyword: e.detail.value });
  },

  onSearch: function () {
    const keyword = this.data.searchKeyword.trim();
    if (!keyword) {
      this.loadFabrics();
      return;
    }

    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .where({
        $or: [
          { code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { new_code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { type: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) }
        ]
      })
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('搜索失败', err);
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onImportExcel: function () {
    wx.chooseMessageFile({
      count: 1,
      type: 'file',
      extension: ['xlsx', 'xls'],
      success: res => {
        const tempFilePath = res.tempFiles[0].path;
        this.uploadAndImportExcel(tempFilePath);
      }
    });
  },

  uploadAndImportExcel: function (filePath) {
    wx.showLoading({ title: '导入中...' });
    
    wx.cloud.uploadFile({
      cloudPath: 'excel-import/' + Date.now() + '.xlsx',
      filePath: filePath,
      success: uploadRes => {
        wx.cloud.callFunction({
          name: 'importExcel',
          data: { fileID: uploadRes.fileID },
          success: importRes => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            if (importRes.result.success) {
              wx.showToast({
                title: `成功导入${importRes.result.count}条数据`,
                icon: 'success'
              });
              this.loadFabrics();
            } else {
              wx.showToast({
                title: importRes.result.message || '导入失败',
                icon: 'none'
              });
            }
          },
          fail: err => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            console.error('导入失败', err);
            wx.showToast({
              title: '导入失败',
              icon: 'none'
            });
          }
        });
      },
      fail: err => {
        wx.hideLoading();
        console.error('上传失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '上传失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
      }
    });
  },

  onAddFabric: function () {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: '/pages/fabric-edit/fabric-edit'
    });
  },

  goToDetail: function (e) {
    const id = e.currentTarget.dataset.id;
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/fabric-detail/fabric-detail?id=${id}`
    });
  }
});
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 创建fabric-detail.js - 页面逻辑**

```javascript
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabric: null,
    loading: true
  },

  onLoad: function (options) {
    if (options.id) {
      this.loadFabricDetail(options.id);
    }
  },

  loadFabricDetail: function (id) {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .doc(id)
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabric: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载详情失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onEdit: function () {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/fabric-edit/fabric-edit?id=${this.data.fabric._id}`
    });
  },

  addToQuotation: function () {
    const fabric = this.data.fabric;
    const pages = getCurrentPages();
    const prevPage = pages[pages.length - 2];
    
    if (prevPage && prevPage.route === 'pages/quotation/quotation') {
      if (prevPage.data.selectedFabrics) {
        const selectedFabrics = [...prevPage.data.selectedFabrics, {
          ...fabric,
          quantity: 1,
          unit: '米',
          unitPrice: fabric.sample_price_meter || 0,
          remark: ''
        }];
        prevPage.setData({ selectedFabrics });
      }
      wx.navigateBack();
    } else {
      wx.switchTab({
        url: '/pages/quotation/quotation'
      });
    }
  }
});
```

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 创建index.js - 页面逻辑**

```javascript
const util = require('../../utils/util.js');
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabrics: [],
    searchKeyword: '',
    loading: false
  },

  onLoad: function () {
    this.loadFabrics();
  },

  onPullDownRefresh: function () {
    this.loadFabrics().then(() => {
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh();
    });
  },

  loadFabrics: function () {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    return db.collection('fabrics')
      .orderBy('create_time', 'desc')
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载面料失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onSearchInput: function (e) {
    this.setData({ searchKeyword: e.detail.value });
  },

  onSearch: function () {
    const keyword = this.data.searchKeyword.trim();
    if (!keyword) {
      this.loadFabrics();
      return;
    }

    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .where({
        $or: [
          { code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { new_code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { type: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) }
        ]
      })
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('搜索失败', err);
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onImportExcel: function () {
    wx.chooseMessageFile({
      count: 1,
      type: 'file',
      extension: ['xlsx', 'xls'],
      success: res => {
        const tempFilePath = res.tempFiles[0].path;
        this.uploadAndImportExcel(tempFilePath);
      }
    });
  },

  uploadAndImportExcel: function (filePath) {
    wx.showLoading({ title: '导入中...' });
    
    wx.cloud.uploadFile({
      cloudPath: 'excel-import/' + Date.now() + '.xlsx',
      filePath: filePath,
      success: uploadRes => {
        wx.cloud.callFunction({
          name: 'importExcel',
          data: { fileID: uploadRes.fileID },
          success: importRes => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            if (importRes.result.success) {
              wx.showToast({
                title: `成功导入${importRes.result.count}条数据`,
                icon: 'success'
              });
              this.loadFabrics();
            } else {
              wx.showToast({
                title: importRes.result.message || '导入失败',
                icon: 'none'
              });
            }
          },
          fail: err => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            console.error('导入失败', err);
            wx.showToast({
              title: '导入失败',
              icon: 'none'
            });
          }
        });
      },
      fail: err => {
        wx.hideLoading();
        console.error('上传失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '上传失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
      }
    });
  },

  onAddFabric: function () {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: '/pages/fabric-edit/fabric-edit'
    });
  },

  goToDetail: function (e) {
    const id = e.currentTarget.dataset.id;
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/fabric-detail/fabric-detail?id=${id}`
    });
  }
});
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 创建fabric-detail.js - 页面逻辑**

```javascript
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabric: null,
    loading: true
  },

  onLoad: function (options) {
    if (options.id) {
      this.loadFabricDetail(options.id);
    }
  },

  loadFabricDetail: function (id) {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .doc(id)
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabric: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载详情失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onEdit: function () {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/fabric-edit/fabric-edit?id=${this.data.fabric._id}`
    });
  },

  addToQuotation: function () {
    const fabric = this.data.fabric;
    const pages = getCurrentPages();
    const prevPage = pages[pages.length - 2];
    
    if (prevPage && prevPage.route === 'pages/quotation/quotation') {
      if (prevPage.data.selectedFabrics) {
        const selectedFabrics = [...prevPage.data.selectedFabrics, {
          ...fabric,
          quantity: 1,
          unit: '米',
          unitPrice: fabric.sample_price_meter || 0,
          remark: ''
        }];
        prevPage.setData({ selectedFabrics });
      }
      wx.navigateBack();
    } else {
      wx.switchTab({
        url: '/pages/quotation/quotation'
      });
    }
  }
});
```

# 面料报价微信小程序 - 轻量化实施计划

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** 构建一个极简的面料报价微信小程序，使用微信云开发，支持面料管理、报价生成和历史记录功能

**Architecture:** 采用微信云开发架构，前端使用微信小程序原生框架，后端使用微信云数据库和云函数

**Tech Stack:**
- 前端：微信小程序原生框架 (WXML + WXSS + JavaScript)
- 后端：微信云开发 (云数据库、云存储、云函数)
- 数据处理：xlsx库 (Excel解析)

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 创建index.js - 页面逻辑**

```javascript
const util = require('../../utils/util.js');
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabrics: [],
    searchKeyword: '',
    loading: false
  },

  onLoad: function () {
    this.loadFabrics();
  },

  onPullDownRefresh: function () {
    this.loadFabrics().then(() => {
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh();
    });
  },

  loadFabrics: function () {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    return db.collection('fabrics')
      .orderBy('create_time', 'desc')
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载面料失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onSearchInput: function (e) {
    this.setData({ searchKeyword: e.detail.value });
  },

  onSearch: function () {
    const keyword = this.data.searchKeyword.trim();
    if (!keyword) {
      this.loadFabrics();
      return;
    }

    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .where({
        $or: [
          { code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { new_code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { type: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) }
        ]
      })
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('搜索失败', err);
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onImportExcel: function () {
    wx.chooseMessageFile({
      count: 1,
      type: 'file',
      extension: ['xlsx', 'xls'],
      success: res => {
        const tempFilePath = res.tempFiles[0].path;
        this.uploadAndImportExcel(tempFilePath);
      }
    });
  },

  uploadAndImportExcel: function (filePath) {
    wx.showLoading({ title: '导入中...' });
    
    wx.cloud.uploadFile({
      cloudPath: 'excel-import/' + Date.now() + '.xlsx',
      filePath: filePath,
      success: uploadRes => {
        wx.cloud.callFunction({
          name: 'importExcel',
          data: { fileID: uploadRes.fileID },
          success: importRes => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            if (importRes.result.success) {
              wx.showToast({
                title: `成功导入${importRes.result.count}条数据`,
                icon: 'success'
              });
              this.loadFabrics();
            } else {
              wx.showToast({
                title: importRes.result.message || '导入失败',
                icon: 'none'
              });
            }
          },
          fail: err => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            console.error('导入失败', err);
            wx.showToast({
              title: '导入失败',
              icon: 'none'
            });
          }
        });
      },
      fail: err => {
        wx.hideLoading();
        console.error('上传失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '上传失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
      }
    });
  },

  onAddFabric: function () {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: '/pages/fabric-edit/fabric-edit'
    });
  },

  goToDetail: function (e) {
    const id = e.currentTarget.dataset.id;
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/fabric-detail/fabric-detail?id=${id}`
    });
  }
});
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 创建fabric-detail.js - 页面逻辑**

```javascript
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabric: null,
    loading: true
  },

  onLoad: function (options) {
    if (options.id) {
      this.loadFabricDetail(options.id);
    }
  },

  loadFabricDetail: function (id) {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .doc(id)
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabric: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载详情失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onEdit: function () {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/fabric-edit/fabric-edit?id=${this.data.fabric._id}`
    });
  },

  addToQuotation: function () {
    const fabric = this.data.fabric;
    const pages = getCurrentPages();
    const prevPage = pages[pages.length - 2];
    
    if (prevPage && prevPage.route === 'pages/quotation/quotation') {
      if (prevPage.data.selectedFabrics) {
        const selectedFabrics = [...prevPage.data.selectedFabrics, {
          ...fabric,
          quantity: 1,
          unit: '米',
          unitPrice: fabric.sample_price_meter || 0,
          remark: ''
        }];
        prevPage.setData({ selectedFabrics });
      }
      wx.navigateBack();
    } else {
      wx.switchTab({
        url: '/pages/quotation/quotation'
      });
    }
  }
});
```

> **For agentic workers:** REQUIRED SUB-SKILL: Use superpowers:subagent-driven-development (recommended) or superpowers:executing-plans to implement this plan task-by-task. Steps use checkbox (`- [ ]`) syntax for tracking.

**Goal:** 构建一个极简的面料报价微信小程序，使用微信云开发，支持面料管理、报价生成和历史记录功能

**Architecture:** 采用微信云开发架构，前端使用微信小程序原生框架，后端使用微信云数据库和云函数

**Tech Stack:**
- 前端：微信小程序原生框架 (WXML + WXSS + JavaScript)
- 后端：微信云开发 (云数据库、云存储、云函数)
- 数据处理：xlsx库 (Excel解析)

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 创建index.js - 页面逻辑**

```javascript
const util = require('../../utils/util.js');
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabrics: [],
    searchKeyword: '',
    loading: false
  },

  onLoad: function () {
    this.loadFabrics();
  },

  onPullDownRefresh: function () {
    this.loadFabrics().then(() => {
      wx.stopPullDownRefresh();
    });
  },

  loadFabrics: function () {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    return db.collection('fabrics')
      .orderBy('create_time', 'desc')
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载面料失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onSearchInput: function (e) {
    this.setData({ searchKeyword: e.detail.value });
  },

  onSearch: function () {
    const keyword = this.data.searchKeyword.trim();
    if (!keyword) {
      this.loadFabrics();
      return;
    }

    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .where({
        $or: [
          { code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { new_code: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) },
          { type: db.RegExp({ regexp: keyword, options: 'i' }) }
        ]
      })
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabrics: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('搜索失败', err);
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onImportExcel: function () {
    wx.chooseMessageFile({
      count: 1,
      type: 'file',
      extension: ['xlsx', 'xls'],
      success: res => {
        const tempFilePath = res.tempFiles[0].path;
        this.uploadAndImportExcel(tempFilePath);
      }
    });
  },

  uploadAndImportExcel: function (filePath) {
    wx.showLoading({ title: '导入中...' });
    
    wx.cloud.uploadFile({
      cloudPath: 'excel-import/' + Date.now() + '.xlsx',
      filePath: filePath,
      success: uploadRes => {
        wx.cloud.callFunction({
          name: 'importExcel',
          data: { fileID: uploadRes.fileID },
          success: importRes => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            if (importRes.result.success) {
              wx.showToast({
                title: `成功导入${importRes.result.count}条数据`,
                icon: 'success'
              });
              this.loadFabrics();
            } else {
              wx.showToast({
                title: importRes.result.message || '导入失败',
                icon: 'none'
              });
            }
          },
          fail: err => {
            wx.hideLoading();
            console.error('导入失败', err);
            wx.showToast({
              title: '导入失败',
              icon: 'none'
            });
          }
        });
      },
      fail: err => {
        wx.hideLoading();
        console.error('上传失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '上传失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
      }
    });
  },

  onAddFabric: function () {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: '/pages/fabric-edit/fabric-edit'
    });
  },

  goToDetail: function (e) {
    const id = e.currentTarget.dataset.id;
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/fabric-detail/fabric-detail?id=${id}`
    });
  }
});
```

- [ ] **Step 4: 创建fabric-detail.js - 页面逻辑**

```javascript
const db = wx.cloud.database();

Page({
  data: {
    fabric: null,
    loading: true
  },

  onLoad: function (options) {
    if (options.id) {
      this.loadFabricDetail(options.id);
    }
  },

  loadFabricDetail: function (id) {
    this.setData({ loading: true });
    db.collection('fabrics')
      .doc(id)
      .get()
      .then(res => {
        this.setData({
          fabric: res.data,
          loading: false
        });
      })
      .catch(err => {
        console.error('加载详情失败', err);
        wx.showToast({
          title: '加载失败',
          icon: 'none'
        });
        this.setData({ loading: false });
      });
  },

  onEdit: function () {
    wx.navigateTo({
      url: `/pages/fabric-edit/fabric-edit?id=${this.data.fabric._id}`
    });
  },

  addToQuotation: function () {
    const fabric = this.data.fabric;
    const pages = getCurrentPages();
    const prevPage = pages[pages.length - 2];
    
    if (prevPage && prevPage.route === 'pages/quotation/quotation') {
      if (prevPage.data.selectedFabrics) {
        const selectedFabrics = [...prevPage.data.selectedFabrics, {
          ...fabric,
          quantity: 1,
          unit: '米',
          unitPrice: fabric.sample_price_meter || 0,
          remark: ''
        }];
        prevPage.setData({ selectedFabrics });
      }
      wx.navigateBack();
    } else {
      wx.switchTab({
        url: '/pages/quotation/quotation'
      });
    }
  }
});
```

- [ ] **Step 5: 创建工具函数 util.js**

```javascript
const formatTime = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  const hour = date.getHours();
  const minute = date.getMinutes();
  const second = date.getSeconds();

  return `${[year, month, day].map(formatNumber).join('/')} ${[hour, minute, second].map(formatNumber).join(':')}`;
};

const formatNumber = n => {
  n = n.toString();
  return n[1] ? n : `0${n}`;
};

const formatDate = date => {
  const year = date.getFullYear();
  const month = date.getMonth() + 1;
  const day = date.getDate();
  return `${year}-${formatNumber(month)}-${formatNumber(day)}`;
};

module.exports = {
  formatTime,
  formatDate
};
```
